raw.excerpt: Company Overview hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm.
raw.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensures that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

You will own a multi-agent research system as production infrastructure: make it faster, cheaper, measurably better and efficient.

hermeneutic Research Labs is the firm’s applied research and engineering unit. Its first product is a research intelligence platform for both traditional and digital-asset markets, built with our researchers and traders and used by them every day. The platform turns market, on-chain, macro and news data into event-driven research that trading decisions rely on. The platform is held to the standard we apply to our own trading: rigorous, falsifiable and measured on outcomes.

The Labs is making a multi-year investment to turn the platform into production infrastructure that a growing set of internal users can depend on. As part of that investment, it is hiring a Lead AI Engineer.

The LLM layer is yours for years. A research query runs through multiple agent stages across several model providers and our own self-hosted models. You start with your hands on the system, writing code and running experiments. As the function grows, you will hire and lead its engineers. The role is built to grow into Head of AI Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Keep the LLM layer reliable: latency budgets, concurrency and queueing, declared degradation modes, structured-output validation and provider failover.
  • Build evaluation tied to research outcomes: offline sets from real queries with outcome labels, online experiments, regression gates on every change, and model-generated confidence calibrated with quantitative research before it reaches a decision.
  • Control cost and routing: per-workload cost attribution, difficulty-based routing between small and frontier models, caching and batching, and the economics of self-hosted serving and GPU capacity.
  • Run model strategy and lifecycle: pinned model versions, replayable test batteries before any change, one-step rollback, provider diversification, and fine-tuning or adapters where they pay.
  • Shape the agent architecture with evidence: ablate and retire components that do not earn their keep, and improve tool use, memory and retrieval only where they move research outcomes.
  • Ground and trace outputs: citation, hallucination controls, audit trails, and the boundary between what a model may assert and what it may only suggest.
  • Build the team: review and mentor engineers now, and hire and lead an AI engineering group as the function grows.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of software or ML engineering, including 3+ years shipping LLM-backed systems to real users in production, where you owned latency, cost and quality, and 2+ years leading other engineers while still shipping.
  • A track record of building a function from nothing.
  • Command of inference economics: tokens, caching, routing, structured outputs, tool use and quantisation, with cost-per-request figures for the systems you ran.
  • Measurement discipline: you instrument before changing anything, evaluate against outcomes rather than model judges, have built an eval that caught what a vibe check missed, and have retired a component with data.
  • Strong Python, including async concurrency.
  • Experience with self-hosted serving (vLLM or similar), adapters and GPU capacity planning, or an end-to-end provider migration.
  • Depth in vector and graph retrieval, built and measured, with an informed view on when retrieval is the wrong fix.

Technologies named here are what we run today, not a filter. We hire for depth and judgement.

Desired Attributes

  • Directness: you tell the author when their component does not earn its keep.
  • Sound judgement working alongside AI coding agents on a largely AI-written codebase, keeping ownership of what ships.
  • Initiative: you take on the hard, unowned problem first, and bring the profiling data and a first fix.
  • Bonus: fine-tuning and preference optimisation in production, and an informed view on when multi-agent frameworks are over-built.
  • Bonus: finance or trading exposure, and experience hiring engineers.

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Hiring Manager Screen – A conversation about the LLM systems you have run in production.
  3. Systems Deep-Dive – A whiteboard session on LLM systems design.
  4. Hands-On Round – A take-home on a synthetic trace set with a review, or a live debugging session.
  5. Reliability and Measurement Scenarios – A scenario discussion with peers from research or risk.
  6. Collaboration and AI-Assisted Work – A conversation on how you work with teammates and AI coding agents.
  7. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to assess your capabilities, strategic thinking, and cultural fit.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

The Channel Company is the global leader in data-driven growth acceleration solutions and services for the IT channel. With 40+ years of channel expertise and a premier portfolio of editorial brands, marketing and event services, and strategic consulting, we help technology vendors, solution providers, and IT decision-makers worldwide unlock better business outcomes.

Our global audience of technology decision-makers rely on our trusted portfolio of print and digital publications to stay current with technology news and trends. Channel-focused marketing, in-demand events, partner program enablement, leadership networks, and dedicated consultants empower channel leaders with insights, connections, and strategies that propel success in the IT channel.

The Channel Company values differences because they enhance dynamic teams. We know that the confidence gap can get in the way of connecting with the best candidates. Please do not hesitate to apply – we would be honored to connect with you.

About the role

The Partner Marketing Specialist works on behalf of a large global IT vendor in the cloud computing space, supporting the enablement of its partner network at scale. The role focuses on increasing awareness and driving adoption of the vendor's existing marketing tools, platforms and resources, empowering partners to independently leverage the support available to them.

Our Partner Marketing Specialists engage with both partners and internal teams across a range of activities, including promoting marketing platforms and partner-ready resources, supporting the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF), and providing guidance on marketing processes, best practices and vendor guidelines. They deliver one-to-one partner support and onboarding, while also driving enablement at scale through webinars, workshops and bootcamps, delivered both virtually and in person.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner and Internal Enablement: Drive awareness and understanding of the vendor's marketing tools, platforms, resources and processes across the partner network and internal teams.
  • Marketing Platform Adoption: Promote the use of the vendor's marketing platform, ensuring partners are aware of and able to access available partner-ready campaigns, templates, marketing assets and other resources to support their marketing activities.
  • Marketing Funding Enablement: Support partner awareness and adoption of marketing funding programmes. Ensure partners understand their eligibility, available opportunities, funding guidelines and the processes required to access and use funding.
  • Marketing Process and Guidelines: Educate partners and internal stakeholders on the vendor's marketing guidelines, best practices and operational processes, including lead tagging requirements and other key marketing mechanisms.
  • Partner Onboarding and Engagement: Manage one-to-one partner conversations and onboarding sessions, helping partners navigate available resources and understand how to leverage the vendor's marketing ecosystem.
  • Enablement Activities: Collaborate with internal teams to develop and deliver enablement initiatives at scale, including webinars, workshops and bootcamps, both virtually and in person.
  • Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams to ensure they are familiar with available marketing resources, platforms and processes, enabling them to effectively guide and support partners.
  • Reporting and Insights: Maintain reporting on enablement activities, platform adoption and partner engagement, providing visibility into progress and identifying opportunities to improve awareness and adoption.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Fluent written and spoken English, with strong communication and interpersonal skills. Additional European language is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to deliver engaging presentations and training sessions to large audiences, both in person and virtually. Ability to communicate information clearly, simplify complex topics and adapt messaging to different audiences.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to establish trust with partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities and proactively identify opportunities to improve enablement and adoption.
  • Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint and Word.
  • Curious about AI and emerging technologies, with an interest in exploring and creating AI agents to simplify ways of working, improve efficiency and maximise impact.

Benefits:

  • 35 hours of work per week
  • Generous Holiday package + National bank holidays
  • Opportunity to join a growing business with lots of opportunities to influence.
  • 100% Remote working. We have the best of both worlds with a historical remote working setup and an office in London or Madrid.
  • Temporary International Remote Working Opportunities
  • Life assurance scheme
  • Employee referral scheme
  • A tailored training and induction plan - we want you to succeed!
  • Regular recognition rewards - be recognized and rewarded for day-to-day actions where you go above and beyond, and consistently deliver
  • Volunteering days
  • The opportunity to work within a globally diverse team
  • The opportunity to learn new skills in an ever-changing and adaptable business.

About the company Impare:

Imparé, a Silicon Valley–based startup and a subsidiary of Jaffer Business Systems (JBS), marks JBS's first international investment and a significant step toward advancing Pakistan's presence in the global semiconductor industry. With this milestone, JBS has positioned itself at the forefront of chip verification services in the country. The company is building a verification hub in Pakistan, designed to support leading semiconductor firms worldwide while nurturing local engineering talent. Through world-class training and real-world project exposure, Imparé empowers Pakistani engineers to collaborate with global technology leaders — bridging innovation, expertise, and opportunity across borders.

Responsibilities:

  • Complete mandatory technical training in digital design, RTL, SystemVerilog, UVM and verification fundamentals.
  • Support testbench development and verification activities under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Read and understand design specifications and develop verification plans and test cases.
  • Write basic SystemVerilog and UVM testbenches, including directed and constrained-random tests.
  • Perform simulation runs, analyze waveforms and debug design and verification issues.
  • Develop and execute regression tests and track verification coverage.
  • Assist in writing and debugging RTL for assigned features or design blocks.
  • Use assertions and coverage metrics to evaluate design functionality.
  • Develop Python or Shell scripts to automate regression, debugging or reporting tasks.
  • Maintain code, test results and project documentation using Git and other engineering tools.
  • Communicate progress, report technical issues and present results to senior engineers and reviewers.

Requirements:

  • Experience: Relevant experience in RTL design, digital design, verification, FPGA or ASIC development.
  • Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Computer or Electronic Engineering.

Technical Skills:

  • Understanding of digital design fundamentals, RTL, FSMs and pipelining.
  • Basic knowledge of Verilog/SystemVerilog and UVM.
  • Familiarity with simulation, waveform analysis and debugging.
  • Basic scripting knowledge in Python or Shell.
  • Understanding of verification concepts, testbenches, assertions and functional coverage.

Additional Advantage: Exposure to AXI, APB, Ethernet, PCIe or UCIe protocols, FPGA projects or formal verification.

Key Expectations: Ability to learn quickly, take ownership of assigned tasks, communicate progress clearly and work effectively in a structured engineering environment.

raw.description:
About the Role

The Coding Specialist is responsible for independently reviewing, analyzing, and resolving all assigned front-end scrubs and denied claims to ensure accurate and timely claim payment. This position focuses on identifying and correcting coding-related issues prior to claim submission, resubmitting corrected claims or appealing denied claims, applying established coding guidelines, payer requirements, and organizational policies. The Coding Specialist works closely with revenue cycle partners to prevent claim rejections, support clean claim rates, and promote efficient reimbursement processes. This role requires strong attention to detail, foundational coding knowledge, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

A Day in the Life

  • Averages 10 front-end holds/denials per hour
  • Reviews coding and resubmits corrected claims to insurance
  • Creates appeal letters/forms with medical documentation
  • Maintains a minimum of 92% coding accuracy.
  • Assigns ICD-10-CM and CPT codes with appropriate modifiers for services provided in the professional fee environment.
  • Reviews medical records and all applicable documentation to determine appropriate codes for documented services and diagnoses.
  • Ensures all diagnosis codes meet local and national medical necessity guidelines.
  • Utilizes internal coding resources, payer guidelines, and other reference materials to ensure accurate and compliant coding for all assigned services.
  • Follows all HIPAA regulations and upholds the highest standards of privacy and confidentiality.
  • Maintains current knowledge of laws, regulations, payer policies, and industry guidance impacting compliant coding practices.
  • Independently reviews and resolves all assigned front-end claim holds.
  • Actively participates in department meetings, one-on-one meetings, and mentorship meetings with the assigned Coding Team Lead.

raw.description:
Please review the job details below.

Intuitive Machines - West (formerly Lanteris Space Systems) is currently seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our Simulations team in San Jose, CA, or a US remote location. In this role, you will provide technical leadership in designing and implementing software for spacecraft simulators used by internal and external customers, while shaping the technical direction of our simulation architecture and mentoring engineering staff across the organization.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and drive the technical vision and architecture for spacecraft simulation systems across multiple programs and projects
  • Lead the evaluation and adoption of new simulation technologies, frameworks, and methodologies to advance organizational capabilities
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on simulation architecture, distributed systems, and real-time modeling for the organization
  • Identify and resolve complex technical issues that span multiple subsystems and require evaluation of intangible factors and trade-offs
  • Create and maintain formal networks with key technical decision-makers across engineering disciplines, program management, and customer organizations

Technical Execution

  • Design and implement sophisticated models of spacecraft components and/or subsystems for all-software spacecraft simulators, addressing significant and unique technical challenges
  • Read, interpret, and provide authoritative guidance on spacecraft hardware specifications, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and technical documentation
  • Architect and enhance complex simulation codebases, making critical decisions on system architecture, design patterns, and long-term maintainability
  • Champion satellite and software industry best practices and drive their adoption across simulation projects
  • Establish standards and best practices for CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and software quality

Leadership & Influence

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers at all levels, from entry-level through senior staff
  • Lead technical design reviews and serve as the authoritative voice on simulation architecture decisions
  • Coordinate activities across multiple engineering teams to ensure coherent system designs and successful integration
  • Represent the organization externally as a technical spokesperson at customer meetings, industry conferences, and technical forums
  • Contribute to business development by providing technical expertise for proposals and customer engagements
  • Drive innovation in simulation methodologies and contribute to the company's technical roadmap

Collaboration & Communication

  • Communicate cross-functionally with software, systems, hardware, and program management to ensure alignment on technical objectives
  • Lead customer-facing design reviews and technical discussions with senior stakeholders
  • Exercise independent judgment in determining methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for solving complex simulation challenges
  • Build and maintain formal networks involving coordination among multiple engineering groups

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
  • Requires a minimum of 15 years of related professional software development experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Aerospace Engineering, or related disciplines
    • OR 10 years with a Master's degree
    • OR 8 years with a PhD
    • OR equivalent experience (four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree)
  • 10+ years of demonstrated expertise in simulation of spacecraft or other complex physical systems
  • Proven track record of technical leadership on multiple significant programs or projects

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level proficiency in reading, interpreting, and providing guidance on technical documentation (hardware specifications, ICDs, datasheets, system architecture documents)
  • Deep expertise in software architecture for complex, real-time simulation systems
  • Expert proficiency with Linux development environments
  • Extensive experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and software quality practices at organizational scale
  • Authoritative knowledge in the following:
    • Developing large-scale software systems in C++ and Python (expert-level C++ required)
    • Architecting and debugging complex distributed systems
    • Software development life cycle best practices and process improvement
    • Agile methodologies and technical leadership within Agile teams
    • Modern software engineering tools and practices

Leadership & Communication

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives that span multiple teams or disciplines
  • Proven mentorship and technical coaching of engineers at various experience levels
  • Strong executive communication skills with ability to present complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
  • Track record of influencing technical direction at the organizational level

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced Technical Skills

  • Deep expertise in applied mathematics with proven ability to architect and implement sophisticated mathematical algorithms (numerical methods, linear algebra, differential equations, computational physics, control theory)
  • Expert knowledge of simulation standards and frameworks such as HLA (High Level Architecture), DIS, or TENA
  • Extensive experience with distributed simulation architectures, real-time synchronization, and middleware (DDS, ZeroMQ, RTI)
  • Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP network programming, including low-latency and real-time communication protocols
  • Expert understanding of spacecraft hardware interfaces and protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, SpaceWire, MIL-STD-1553)
  • Deep knowledge of spacecraft command and telemetry protocols (CCSDS, Space Packet Protocol)
  • Mastery of software design patterns, object-oriented design, and software architecture principles
  • Experience architecting containerized and cloud-native simulation systems (Docker, Kubernetes)

Domain Expertise

  • Significant experience in spacecraft operations, design, testing, or mission support
  • Published work or conference presentations in simulation, aerospace, or related technical fields
  • Industry recognition or leadership roles in professional organizations related to simulation or aerospace
  • Active U.S. citizenship and current or past security clearance (or ability to obtain TS/SCI for classified programs)

Leadership & Strategic Impact

  • Track record of defining technical roadmaps for simulation systems or similar complex software
  • Experience with business development, including technical proposal leadership and customer engagement at executive levels
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and champion adoption of emerging technologies that create competitive advantage
  • History of building and leading technical communities of practice or centers of excellence
  • Cross-organizational influence with demonstrated ability to drive technical standards and best practices company-wide

Personal Attributes

  • Strategic thinking with ability to balance long-term technical vision with near-term execution needs
  • Exceptional problem-solving ability for issues involving evaluation of intangible factors and complex trade-offs
  • Passion for space exploration and commitment to mission success
  • Executive presence and credibility with senior technical and business leadership
  • Continuous learning mindset and drive to stay at the forefront of simulation and aerospace technology

Role Snapshot

The Medical Review Nurse Analyst is responsible for conducting clinical reviews of medical records to ensure compliance with regulatory and payer guidelines. This role ensures that providers are billing and being paid appropriately for services provided based on Medicare guidelines. The Medical Review Nurse Analyst reviews claims and delivers provider education on current billing and documentation requirements.

Salary Range

68,000-70,000

The base pay offered for this position may vary within the posted range based on your job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We are open to remote work in the following approved states:
Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Jersey, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin

  • Perform detailed reviews of medical records and documentation to determine the medical necessity of services.
  • Review submitted claims to ensure that billed services are medically necessary and correctly coded based on Medicare guidelines. Ensure Medicare providers are correctly reimbursed when documentation supports services rendered.
  • Prepare written clinical summaries and determinations with clear rationale for approvals, denials, or modifications.
  • Educate providers in accordance with the Targeted Probe and Educate (TPE) program.
  • Monitor the progress of assigned providers and educate on current billing and documentation requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with federal and state regulations, CMS guidelines, and company policies.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex medical information clearly and concisely.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills to manage multiple cases simultaneously.
  • Basic knowledge and understanding of medical/clinical review processes.
  • Solid computer skills with experience working in multiple on-line systems including MS Outlook, Teams, OneNote, Word, and Excel.

Preferred Qualifications

We process claims and provide customer support for beneficiaries of the Medicare program and manage benefits for millions of active-duty and retired military personnel across the U.S. and abroad. Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Coding Agent Research & Evaluations

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

We are seeking a Member of Technical Staff to help advance the evaluation and development of frontier coding agents. Sitting at the intersection of AI research, software engineering, and model evaluation, you will design the benchmarks, methodologies, and data systems that shape how next-generation coding models are measured and improved.

What You'll Do

  1. Design and own evaluation frameworks for coding agents, including benchmark specifications, scoring methodologies, rubrics, and quality standards.
  2. Lead end-to-end research initiatives focused on measuring and improving coding model performance across diverse software engineering tasks.
  3. Develop high-quality datasets, golden examples, and evaluation protocols that enable reliable assessment of frontier coding systems.
  4. Analyze model behavior and failure modes, identifying systematic weaknesses and translating findings into actionable improvements for training and evaluation.
  5. Build tooling and infrastructure that support large-scale experimentation, data generation, review workflows, and evaluation pipelines.
  6. Establish best practices for coding-agent assessment, ensuring methodological rigor, reproducibility, and measurement quality.
  7. Partner closely with researchers, engineers, and applied AI teams to design experiments and evaluate emerging model capabilities.
  8. Contribute to technical reports, benchmark studies, and client-facing research initiatives that communicate model performance and insights.

What We're Looking For

  1. Strong software engineering background with expertise in Python, C++, or comparable programming languages.
  2. 3+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning, AI research, evaluation, or related technical disciplines.
  3. Experience designing, reviewing, or validating technical assessments, benchmarks, coding tasks, or evaluation methodologies.
  4. Familiarity with large language models, coding agents, reinforcement learning, model evaluation, or related AI systems.
  5. Proven ability to build tooling, automate workflows, and improve technical processes through systematic experimentation.
  6. Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate model behavior and derive insights from complex technical systems.
  7. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate technical findings to diverse audiences.
  8. Comfortable operating in fast-moving research environments with significant ambiguity and evolving priorities.

Preferred

  1. Experience working on frontier AI systems, coding agents, or model evaluation research.
  2. Deep interest in understanding how data, evaluations, and feedback mechanisms influence model capabilities.
  3. Track record of independently driving ambiguous technical or research projects from conception to execution.
  4. Experience designing benchmarks or datasets for machine learning systems at scale.
  5. Familiarity with agentic workflows, tool use, reinforcement learning, or post-training methodologies.
  6. Publications, open-source contributions, or demonstrated technical leadership in AI, machine learning, or software engineering.

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $200,000 –$260,000 USD. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. The company provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

The Lead Azure Data Engineer will be reporting to VP of Data Engineering and will be responsible for implementing data solutions and collaborating with Business Analyst, Data Analyst, IT Teams and key stake holders. What will your job entail?

  • Provide technical leadership in data architecture and engineering, collaborating with solution stakeholders to align data solutions with business objectives.

Sobre a Clicksign

Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.

Como trabalhamos:

Nossa essência é o Trust. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Trabalhamos com capricho; colocamos cuidado e qualidade em tudo que fazemos. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.

Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Analista de Implementação de Integrações Pleno (CS), com foco na condução de projetos técnicos e na experiência dos clientes durante o processo de integração via API. Nessa posição, você será responsável por acompanhar os clientes desde o entendimento das necessidades e diagnóstico técnico até a entrada em operação, conectando clientes, decisores e desenvolvedores, garantindo clareza de escopo, alinhamento entre as partes, organização das etapas, cumprimento de prazos e uma jornada de integração mais eficiente. Você fará parte do time responsável por impulsionar a ativação e o engajamento dos clientes, contribuindo para tornar as integrações mais simples, ágeis e previsíveis, atuando de forma colaborativa e remota.

Condução Técnica e Consultiva
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas de integração com decisores e desenvolvedores.
  • Estruturar diagnóstico técnico com base em checklist padronizado.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros.
  • Apoiar definição da arquitetura de integração (uso interno/externo, webhooks, autenticação, modelos, UX, etc.).
Gestão de Projeto Técnico
  • Definir cronograma e marcos de implementação junto ao cliente.
  • Identificar riscos técnicos e gargalos de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar preventivamente para evitar retrabalho.
  • Garantir clareza sobre escopo e responsabilidades.
Governança e Evolução Contínua
  • Capturar padrões recorrentes e retroalimentar o framework de integração.
  • Apoiar evolução do Guia de API, glossário e materiais técnicos.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Produto, Comercial e CS para alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Apoiar casos prioritários da base ativa quando necessário.
  • Experiência prévia com onboarding técnico ou implantação em empresas SaaS.
  • Vivência com integrações via API REST.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de documentação técnica.
  • Experiência conduzindo reuniões com times técnicos e decisores.
  • Organização e gestão de múltiplos projetos simultâneos.
  • Comunicação clara e didática.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de integração (webhooks, autenticação, tokens, fluxos de assinatura).
  • Experiência com métricas de onboarding (Time to Value, Activation Rate).
  • Vivência em projetos cross-funcionais.
  • Noções de lógica técnica ou background técnico (não precisa programar, mas precisa entender).

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Perfil consultivo e estruturado.
  • Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica.
  • Comunicação segura com público técnico e executivo.
  • Proatividade e senso de dono.
  • Capacidade de antecipar riscos.
  • Organização e disciplina de governança.

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Cultura de confiança, focada em resultados e com muito desafio e aprendizado.
  • Autonomia e protagonismo, em um ambiente cheio de colaboração e empatia.
  • Cultura de feedback e 1:1 com uma liderança humana e sem microgerenciamento.
  • Benefícios completos como: vale refeição/alimentação, auxílios creche, home office, saúde, educação e cultura, gympass, day-off de aniversário, descontos em terapia e cursos de inglês, entre outras parcerias.

At World Fuel, our employees are the key to our global success. We are industry leaders due to the innumerable talents of our approximately 5000 strong professional team. Our people thrive in an entrepreneurial and culturally-diverse environment, where innovative thinking, collaboration and efficient execution are highly valued. Our high-performance culture is what allows us to drive sustained growth. Stronger together, we promote an environment where individuals can thrive.

About World Fuel

At World Fuel, we are driven by our mission to keep the world moving. Through our global network, we provide fuel, logistics, energy, and aviation solutions to commercial, government, defense, and humanitarian customers worldwide. Our Government Solutions business supports military organizations, government agencies, prime contractors, and international institutions through reliable fuel supply, logistics coordination, operational support, and mission-critical services around the globe.

Job Summary

The Trip Services & Operations Manager is responsible for coordinating the delivery of aviation support services for government, military, and defense customers worldwide. The role serves as the primary operational liaison between customers, airport service providers, fuel suppliers, ground handlers, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution of mission-critical aviation operations. The successful candidate will focus on operational service delivery, vendor coordination, customer communications, issue resolution, and supplier performance management across a global network of aviation service providers.

Vendor Coordination & Service Delivery

  • Serve as the primary operational interface with airport handlers, fuel suppliers, catering providers, transportation companies, and other aviation service providers.
  • Coordinate service delivery requirements and ensure suppliers understand customer expectations and operational requirements.
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with operational vendors across a global network.
  • Monitor supplier responsiveness, service quality, and operational performance.
  • Support onboarding and qualification of new service providers as required.

Issue Resolution & Customer Support

  • Lead the resolution of operational disruptions, service failures, customer concerns, and supplier performance issues.
  • Conduct root-cause investigations and coordinate corrective actions with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Serve as an escalation point for critical operational issues requiring immediate attention.
  • Provide timely updates to customers and stakeholders throughout issue-resolution processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of operational activities, service issues, and corrective actions.

Trip Services Operations

  • Coordinate aviation support services including fuel, ground handling, aircraft parking, permits, transportation, accommodations, and other mission-support requirements.
  • Monitor active missions and ensure operational services are delivered in accordance with customer requirements.
  • Act as a central coordination point between customers, suppliers, and operational teams throughout service delivery.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

  • Experience in aviation operations, trip support, ground handling, logistics coordination, supplier management, or customer operations.
  • Proven ability to manage supplier relationships and resolve operational issues in a customer-focused environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience coordinating multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting government, military, defense, or humanitarian aviation operations.
  • Knowledge of airport operations, aircraft ground handling, fuel services, or trip support activities.
  • Experience managing aviation suppliers and service providers.
  • Familiarity with operational reporting, performance management, and service-level monitoring.

  2. Strong background in protective relaying, relay settings, power system analysis, and device coordination.
  3. Proficiency with SEL, GE, or standard microprocessor relays and associated software.
  4. Advanced skill in power system modeling tools such as ETAP, ASPEN, or CAPE.
  5. Ability to synthesize and communicate complex technical concepts clearly in both written and verbal formats.

Business Unit Overview

Group Benefit Solutions delivers comprehensive insurance and absence management solutions for mid-size and large companies. Our work fosters a healthier, happier and more secure workforce, contributing to New York Life’s legacy of being there when we’re needed most. Here, you’ll design, implement and support these solutions directly impacting customers’ lives. At our core, we provide financial security and peace of mind to people through our absence, accident, disability, voluntary benefits and life insurance solutions.

Role Overview

The Enrollment Consultant serves as a strategic enrollment subject matter expert, partnering with Sales, Client Management, brokers, clients, and internal partners to develop enrollment strategies that support employee engagement, participation, and growth.

The role combines enrollment expertise, market insight, client needs, and data to recommend the right enrollment approach for each case. Enrollment Consultants help shape enrollment strategy from initial planning through post-enrollment evaluation, identifying opportunities to improve outcomes and maximize the value of available enrollment capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Develop enrollment strategies based on client objectives, employee demographics, product mix, enrollment environment, available capabilities, and desired outcomes.

  • Serve as a strategic enrollment consultant to Sales and Client Management, providing recommendations on enrollment approaches, solutions, communications, and support.

  • Participate in client and broker conversations as the enrollment subject matter expert, helping articulate enrollment capabilities and recommend strategies aligned with the client’s needs.

  • Use enrollment data and results to drive recommendations by identifying trends, opportunities, and changes that could improve future enrollment performance.

  • Partner with internal teams from enrollment strategy development through post-enrollment evaluation to ensure the strategy is understood, supported, and executed effectively.

  • Evaluate enrollment outcomes to understand what worked, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend adjustments for future enrollment strategies.

  • Identify client and market needs through engagement with Sales, Client Management, brokers, clients, and other partners, bringing insights back to the organization to inform future enrollment capabilities.

  • Evaluate existing and emerging enrollment solutions to identify where tools, technologies, communication approaches, and resources can create the greatest value.

  • Support pilots and new enrollment approaches by identifying appropriate cases, contributing enrollment expertise, and evaluating results to help determine value and broader applicability.

  • Partner with Marketing and other internal teams to help ensure enrollment communications and solutions remain relevant to evolving client and market needs.

  • Build strong relationships across Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Marketing, and other partners, becoming a trusted resource for strategic enrollment consultation.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience in enrollment and/or group insurance.

  • Strong knowledge of enrollment practices, strategies, marketing approaches, and enrollment solutions.

  • Deep knowledge of group employee benefits, including voluntary and contributory products.

  • Experience with sales, implementation, and enrollment processes.

  • Ability to translate client needs, market insights, and enrollment data into actionable strategies and recommendations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate enrollment results and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Strong consultative skills and the ability to influence decisions through expertise, insights, and recommendations.

  • Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external partners.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate enrollment strategy and recommendations to clients, brokers, Sales, and internal partners.

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple strategic enrollment engagements.

  • Ability to travel within an assigned territory, including periodic overnight travel.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $90,000-$110,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Company Overview

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress.

As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.

Our Benefits

We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work.Click hereto discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. We have a longstanding commitment to creating an environment where individuals can contribute their best and succeed together. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. By embracing a broad range of perspectives and experiences, we achieve greater success and fulfill our promise of providing financial security and peace of mind to families across all communities. Click here to learn more about New York Life’s leadership in this space.​

Recognized as one of Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies, New York Life is committed to improving local communities through a culture of employee giving and volunteerism, supported by the Foundation. We're proud that due to our mutuality, we operate in the best interests of our policy owners. To learn more about career opportunities at New York Life, please visit the Careerspage of .

Visit our Newsroom to learn more about how our company is constantly evolving to meet our clients' and employees’ needs.

raw.description:
About SeedTrust Group

SeedTrust Group is a family of companies working in the assisted-reproduction space. Our businesses provide escrow and financial management for surrogacy, egg donation and fertility journeys, medical records collection, case-management software and payment management.

We handle client funds, payment data and sensitive personal information for families going through some of the most important moments of their lives. We operate in a regulated environment, and we're building the functions that keep us trustworthy as we grow.

Our business and executive leadership is based in the United States, and our team is distributed across the US and Latin America, working on Eastern Time.

The Role

This is a new seat in a newly established Internal Audit function. You'll work directly with the Internal Audit Manager and take on audits across several companies in our group, from planning to final report.

You'll bring the judgment of someone who has done this before: you can scope an audit, test controls, write findings that stand up to scrutiny, and sit across from a department head who disagrees with you. You'll also help shape how the function works, including methodology, templates and the risk-based audit plan.

What You'll Do

  • Plan and run risk-based audits across financial, operational and compliance areas, from scoping through fieldwork, reporting and remediation follow-up.
  • Test controls for design and operating effectiveness, and document your work so anyone can follow your logic.
  • Write clear findings and agree on realistic remediation plans with process owners.
  • Interview department heads and process owners to understand how work really gets done and where the risks are.
  • Contribute to the annual risk assessment and the audit plan that follows from it.
  • Help build the function: workpaper templates, risk and control matrices, testing standards and reporting formats.
  • Review the work of others and give clear, constructive feedback.
  • Partner with Compliance on risk and control topics, while keeping Internal Audit's independence.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of internal audit or equivalent assurance experience, including controls testing and audit reporting.
  • Experience reviewing other auditors' workpapers, or leading parts of an audit.
  • A background in internal audit consulting or advisory (Big 4, a mid-tier firm or a risk advisory practice) or in-house internal audit.
  • Experience working with US companies or US frameworks (e.g., SOX, US GAAP, US regulatory requirements) on audits that included US stakeholders.
  • Advanced professional English, spoken and written. Most of your conversations will be in English with business leaders.
  • Experience with risk assessments and risk and control matrices (RCMs).
  • Comfort working independently and asynchronously in a remote team.
  • CPA, CIA, CISA or an equivalent certification preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services, payments, escrow, insurance or healthcare.
  • Familiarity with SOX, SOC 2 or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with audit tools (e.g., AuditBoard, TeamMate) and data analysis.

Who Thrives Here

  • You're curious, ask good questions and learn new areas fast.
  • You challenge your own work and welcome challenge from others.
  • You take pride in the craft and in the team, not in your title.
  • You're honest about what you don't know yet.
  • You work well with all kinds of personalities, including people who aren't thrilled to be audited.

If you've read this far, enter the word Saffron in the "Reference word" question of the application.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, with the flexibility that comes with independent contracting.
  • Monthly payment in USD against your invoice.
  • Close day-to-day collaboration with a US-based team, not an arm's-length engagement.
  • A professional development roadmap built with your manager, with room to grow your craft.
  • The chance to help build a function from the ground up.

Eligibility

This is an independent-contractor engagement. Candidates must be based in a Latin American country, be able to work as an independent contractor and invoice in their country of residence, and be available for substantial daily overlap with US Eastern Time (roughly 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM ET at minimum). The role involves regulated and confidential data and requires accepting confidentiality terms. We do not work with staffing agencies for this role. Interviews are conducted on video with camera on.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Application and short questionnaire. Please answer in your own words. Specific, honest answers matter more than polished ones.
  2. 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team.
  3. In-depth interview with the Internal Audit Manager.
  4. Conversations with our Compliance and business leaders.
  5. Final conversation with executive leadership.

SeedTrust Group is an equal opportunity organization. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nexford University is a global online university built for working adults who want skills that actually move their careers. We are looking for a Content Marketing Specialist who can turn our learners, faculty and outcomes into stories people stop scrolling for.

About the role

You will own organic social from strategy to post, run our webinar engine, and partner with Creative to bring our brand to life through imagery and video. You will work across Sales, Learner Success and Academics to find the best stories in the building. And you will live in the data, because every post is a test and every test makes the next one better.

What you will do

  • Build and own the organic social strategy, with LinkedIn and Meta as our priority channels and clear goals tied to awareness, engagement and enrollment.
  • Plan the content calendar and write, schedule and publish content daily, owning captions, hooks and platform-native formats.
  • Manage community engagement and flag trends or sentiment shifts early.
  • Coordinate end-to-end webinar production, from topic planning and speaker sourcing to promotion and follow-up.

  • Own social and webinar reporting, share insights with clear “so what” recommendations, and run structured tests on formats, hooks and creative.

What you bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in content marketing, social media marketing or a related role.
  • A portfolio of social content and campaigns you have built, with results to back them up.
  • Strong writing skills, a sharp ear for hooks and voice, and the creative judgment to know what will land.

About NCR Atleos

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

Company profile

NCR Atleos is a global leader in self-service financial access and ATM solutions, providing technology and services to financial institutions and retailers. The company supports ATM deployment, maintenance, managed services, cash management, transaction processing infrastructure, and end-to-end ATM operations.

For the PNB Dispute Management Executive position, the role contributes to operational accuracy and customer service by supporting transaction verification, ATM reconciliation, excess cash investigation, CIT coordination, CCTV verification, and timely closure of GL, suspense, and sundry differences.

Position Summary

The Dispute Management Executive will be responsible for the day-to-day reconciliation, and closure of ATM transaction disputes and related operational differences for the PNB process. The role requires timely investigation of failed transactions, excess cash cases, reconciliation differences, and suspense/sundry items while coordinating with relevant internal and external stakeholders for resolution.

Key Areas of Responsibility

1, Failed Transaction Verification

  • Perform daily verification of failed ATM transactions.
  • Investigate transaction discrepancies and ensure timely resolution of identified exceptions.

2 Excess Cash Verification

  • Check and validate excess cash through C3R and Electronic Journal (EJ) counters.
  • Identify discrepancies between transaction records and reported cash positions.

3 CIT Follow-up

  • Follow up with the CIT team/vendor when excess cash is not reported.
  • Obtain the reason, confirmation, and acceptance for identified excess cases and track them through closure.

4 CCTV Verification

  • Review CCTV footage for suspected or disputed transaction cases wherever investigation requires visual verification.
  • Maintain appropriate records/evidence in accordance with applicable process requirements.

5 Daily Reconciliation

  • Perform reconciliation across Core Banking System (CBS), C3R closing balances, and Switch records.
  • Investigate mismatches and coordinate for timely resolution of reconciliation differences.

6 GL Difference Closure

  • Monitor and resolve General Ledger (GL) related differences.
  • Ensure open reconciliation items are appropriately investigated, documented, and closed within defined timelines.

7 Suspense & Sundry Management

  • Review and work on suspense and sundry files.
  • Follow up on outstanding entries and ensure timely closure of pending items with appropriate supporting documentation.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience, preferably in banking operations, ATM operations, transaction reconciliation, or dispute management.
  • Working knowledge of transaction reconciliation and exception handling.
  • Ability to analyze transaction-level discrepancies and follow cases through to closure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in ATM dispute management, reconciliation, or banking operations.
  • Practical knowledge of C3R, EJ, Switch, GL, suspense, and sundry reconciliation.
  • Experience coordinating with CIT agencies/vendors for cash-related discrepancies.
  • Understanding of failed ATM transactions, excess cash investigation, and transaction dispute processes.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including reconciliation and data analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple cases and meet TATs.

raw.excerpt: Why this role exists We've just moved our CRM to HubSpot and we're modernising .
raw.description:
Why this role exists

We've just moved our CRM to HubSpot and we're modernising . We want one connected system, from the first website visit to a closed deal, that Marketing and Sales both trust and that runs without manual effort. Today too much of our reporting is still done by hand, and our measurement has grown faster than its foundations.

We need one engineer to own the systems behind our growth. You'll architect HubSpot across marketing and sales, ship front-end code on , own the tracking layer and automate the rest. You won't be a product engineer, a designer, a copywriter or a Sales help desk. You'll build the engine that Marketing and Sales run on.

This is a remote-first position. We're looking for a person to be based in the UK, Poland or Switzerland, with occassional trips to our head office in Zurich.

What you'll own

HubSpot and RevOps systems (about 35% of your time)

  • Architecture of our HubSpot portal across Marketing and Sales: data model, custom objects, properties and governance
  • Pipeline and deal-stage configuration, lifecycle stages and lead routing, built with Sales leadership, who own the sales process
  • Attribution from first touch to closed deal, so we know which channels create revenue, not just leads
  • Lead scoring and intent signals that help Sales prioritise
  • Integrations and data quality: syncing HubSpot with our platform data in Databricks, ad platforms and enrichment, with deduplication and property hygiene
  • Self-serve pipeline and marketing dashboards, so teams get answers without filing requests
  • Using CRM data on the website (smart forms, personalisation), making practical use of HubSpot's AI features, and keeping a roadmap of what to build next
  • Deliverability, plus a modular email template system for HubSpot and Intercom

Website and front-end (about 25%)

  • Front-end development of coople.com: page templates, reusable components, Prismic CMS integration and landing pages
  • Performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility (WCAG) and code quality
  • Technical SEO and AI-search discoverability: structured data, crawlability, multilingual setup (DE/FR/IT/EN, hreflang)
  • Marketing's technical lead on the website modernisation programme, including evaluating CMS options. You'll use AI-assisted development to ship at pace, working with our Engineering team, who own infrastructure and deployment standards

Measurement (about 20%)

  • The tracking layer end to end: tag management, event schemas, conversion tracking, and consent under GDPR and Swiss nFADP
  • Monitoring and alerting, so broken tracking is found in hours, not at month-end
  • Connecting web and product analytics to CRM outcomes, with the analytics and data teams owning KPI definitions and warehouse models

Automation and experimentation (about 20%)

  • Internal tools and AI-built automations that remove manual reporting and data-shuffling
  • Keeping the stack lean: tool audits, UTM and naming governance, documented schemas
  • Designing, building and reading out tests across the website and the funnel, starting from a clear hypothesis
  • Bringing your own growth ideas to the team, not just building other people's

Where the line sits: you build and run the systems; marketers decide what goes through them. Campaigns, content and copy stay with Marketing. The sales process, forecasting and enablement stay with Sales leadership. Batch changes and large admin updates are handled with our HubSpot partner, and dashboards are self-serve.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: a HubSpot health check across Marketing and Sales with a prioritised roadmap, a documented tracking plan, the first ad-hoc reports replaced by self-serve dashboards, and your first components shipped to coople.com
  • First 12 months: one trusted view from first visit to closed deal, lead scoring and routing that Sales actually use, clean CRM data synced with our platform, a faster site delivered through the modernisation programme, and a measurably smaller manual-reporting load

What you'll bring

Must have

  • Experience owning a CRM's data model and configuration. HubSpot is preferred, but Salesforce or Marketo experience counts if you're ready to get HubSpot-certified within your first three months
  • Depth in analytics and tag management: GA4, Google Tag Manager (including server-side), consent mode, event design
  • Comfort with data: you can write SQL, work with APIs and shape data in Python or JavaScript
  • A track record of automating recurring work, including with AI tools, that you can show us
  • Day-to-day use of AI-assisted development (for example Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot), with the judgement to review what it produces
  • Proven front-end skills: you have shipped production pages or components with semantic HTML, modern CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript, ideally in a component-based framework (React/Next.js, TBC) with a headless CMS
  • Around 4+ years in web development, marketing technology, RevOps or growth engineering.
  • Fluent English, and the ability to say no to stakeholders constructively
  • The right to work in the country you're based in (UK, PL or CH)

Nice to have

  • RevOps remit like: pipeline design, lead routing, sales-marketing handover
  • Previous experience as a Data Engineer or a CRM Manager could relevant
  • HubSpot development (HubL, custom objects, Operations Hub, APIs)
  • Experimentation tooling (PostHog, Optimizely, VWO) and basic statistics for test readouts
  • Databricks or another data warehouse
  • Responsive email development, multilingual sites, or B2B marketplace experience

Our stack

HubSpot, Prismic, front-end framework (TBC), GA4, Google Tag Manager, PostHog, Intercom, Databricks, Supermetrics, Notion, plus whatever AI tooling helps you work faster. You'll help shape what we keep.

How we hire

  1. Screening call with our inhouse recruiter (20 min)
  2. Intro call with the Head of Growth Marketing (30 min, video)
  3. Technical conversation with Engineering about front-end and tracking (45 min)
  4. A short practical task based on a real HubSpot or automation problem, followed by a walkthrough (60 min)
  5. Conversation with Sales leadership and/or other relevant future team mates (in person or video)

raw.description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

EPE is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer - Substation Design (P.E. required) to lead the engineering and design of medium- and high-voltage substations ranging from 34.5 kV through 345 kV and higher. This role will support our Owner's Engineering group, with a primary emphasis on physical substation design and the delivery of complete engineering packages from conceptual design through Issued for Construction (IFC). The ideal candidate will bring experience leading both greenfield and brownfield substation projects, with a strong understanding of physical design and exposure to Testing & Commissioning (T&C), as well as protection and control (P&C) design.

Our projects include utility-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), wind and hybrid collector substations, point-of-interconnection switching stations, and large-load interconnections supporting data centers and industrial customers across ERCOT and other U.S. markets. As a technical lead, you will guide engineers and designers, review and verify engineering deliverables, and collaborate directly with clients, transmission owners, and EPC contractors to deliver high-quality substation solutions.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Lead design from concept to IFC: Own the technical scope, quality and schedule of substation design packages through conceptual, 30%, 60%, 90% and IFC milestones.

  • Physical design: Develop and check general arrangements, plan and section drawings, electrical clearances and phase spacing, rigid and strain bus design, equipment and structure layouts, ground grid design (IEEE 80), lightning shielding (IEEE 998), raceway (conduit, cable trench, duct bank), lighting and bills of material.

  • P&C design: Develop and check one-line and three-line diagrams, AC and DC schematics, wiring diagrams, relay and control panel layouts, and cable schedules. Apply protection schemes for lines, transformers, buses, breakers and capacitor banks, including line current differential, distance, transformer and bus differential, breaker failure, and communication-assisted tripping (POTT, DTT).

  • Brownfield expansions: Lead field verification and reviews of existing conditions, integrate new bays, line terminals and P&C into energized substations, and develop outage, cutover and construction sequencing with the utility.

  • Utility and market interface: Apply transmission owner design standards and interconnection requirements (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, NYISO and other ISOs/RTOs), and support coordination on metering, telemetry and SCADA/communications.

  • Equipment and vendors: Write technical specifications and evaluate vendor proposals and drawings for power transformers, circuit breakers, switches, instrument transformers, relay panels, control enclosures, station service and DC systems.

  • Design reviews: Review EPC and third-party substation and collection system design packages, and provide clear, actionable comments to clients, both on EPE design projects and on owner's engineering assignments.

  • Proposals and estimating: Support scope development, engineering hour estimates and conceptual cost estimates for new work.

  • Mentoring and QA/QC: Mentor engineers and designers, check their work, and uphold EPE quality standards. Seal drawings as engineer of record where licensed.

  • Coordination and construction support: Coordinate with civil/structural, transmission line, system studies and communications/SCADA teams. Submit and respond to RFIs, and support construction and commissioning.

  • Deliver assigned projects on time while meeting project quality and budget objectives.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with a minimum of six years of high-voltage and MV substation design experience with a utility, consulting firm or EPC.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license (required).

  • Proven experience delivering complete substation design packages from conceptual to IFC, covering both physical and P&C design, at voltages from 34.5 kV to 345 kV or higher.

  • Experience with both greenfield substations and brownfield modifications to existing, energized facilities.

  • Working knowledge of NESC, NFPA, IEEE and utility/transmission owner design standards, and of how NERC requirements apply to substation design.

  • Solid understanding of protection philosophy and protective relays (SEL, GE, Siemens or similar), plus substation communications, SCADA/RTU and revenue metering.

  • Experience with AutoCAD and grounding analysis software (CDEGS, WinIGS or similar).

The Director, Health Services Research and Implementation Science reports to and works under the direction of the Senior Director, Health Services Research and Implementation Science, executing the Association's health services research (HSR) and implementation science (IS) portfolio within Medical & Scientific Relations. The Director translates the strategy and priorities set by the Senior Director into concrete studies, projects, and partnerships, and leads day-to-day delivery of assigned workstreams.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead, under the Senior Director's strategic direction, the development of new implementation research opportunities with Health Systems and Medical Affairs — exercising independent decision-making authority over study design and implementation strategy, and day-to-day leadership of multidisciplinary, matrixed project teams — applying implementation science frameworks to guide study design, technical assistance, and evaluation, and clearly distinguishing implementation research from quality improvement or operational implementation work.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for Medical Affairs and Health Systems teams on implementation research opportunities, building durable working relationships and escalating strategic decisions to the Senior Director.
  • Execute the Association's HSR/IS agenda and priorities as set by the Senior Director, translating strategy into concrete studies, projects, and deliverables.
  • Disseminate HSR/IS methods and findings through peer-reviewed publications, conference sessions, and other field-focused channels, and support the Senior Director's leadership of the ISTAART HSR Special Interest Group.
  • Represent the Association, as directed by the Senior Director, in externally funded (including federally funded) collaborative projects, and contribute to grant development and submission for HSR/IS studies and initiatives.
  • Support the Senior Director in developing and formalizing external partnerships that create joint HSR/IS research, training, or funding opportunities.
  • Provide technical assistance to health system and community implementation teams; lead matrixed project teams as assigned, under the Senior Director's oversight.
  • Apply community-engaged and person-centered research principles across HSR/IS projects, drawing on the Association's lived-experience advisory infrastructure.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by the Senior Director.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • Ability to translate strategic direction into concrete research plans, timelines, and deliverables, and to execute independently within that direction.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary, matrixed project teams — including internal staff, external collaborators, and grant-funded personnel — and to exercise independent decision-making authority over study design and implementation strategy, consistent with project-based leadership models common in research and consulting organizations.
  • Hands-on fluency and ability to engage other disciplines in implementation science frameworks and literature (e.g., RE-AIM, CFIR, EPIS), and the ability to distinguish implementation research from quality improvement or operational implementation.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage external partnerships (academic, health system, or funder relationships) in support of a supervisor's broader strategy.
  • Strong record of peer-reviewed publication and conference presentation.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with clinical, health systems, or medical affairs teams.
  • Ability to work effectively under supervision on strategic direction while exercising sound independent judgment in day-to-day scientific execution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including scientific writing and presentation to internal and external audiences.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Doctoral degree (PhD, DrPH, or equivalent) in health services research, implementation science, public health, health policy, or a related field.
  • Several years of progressively senior experience in health services research and/or implementation science, including hands-on experience applying implementation science frameworks as an implementation scientist embedded in real-world health system or care delivery settings.
  • Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder research or implementation projects without formal supervisory authority — e.g., in a matrixed or project-based organizational structure.
  • Demonstrated experience building or managing external partnerships (academic, health system, or funder relationships).
  • Experience in brain health, aging, dementia, or related chronic disease care settings preferred.
  • Experience with community-engaged or person-centered research methods preferred.
  • Experience in international or multi-site collaborative research preferred.
  • Prior supervisory or team-building experience preferred, given anticipated growth of the function.
  • Familiarity with federal-funding research infrastructure (grants, engagement panels, multi-site studies) preferred.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to represent the Association at external meetings; estimated travel up to 30%.

Location: US Remote

Work Schedule: Full-Time (37.5 hours per week)

Reports To: Senior Director, Health Services Research and Implementation Science
