Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
Reporting to the VP, Mid-Revenue Cycle, the Director, Clinical Documentation Integrity is responsible for developing a unified, multidisciplinary, outcome-focused clinical documentation integrity program. This position evaluates the adequacy and effectiveness of internal and operational controls designed to ensure that CDI processes and practices lead to appropriate execution of regulatory requirements and guidelines related to facility coding and CDI practices, including federal and state compliance standards. This position plays a key role in leading the initiative for reporting quality of care outcomes and in obtaining complete, accurate and compliant documentation for appropriate reimbursement of services provided and capture of clinical outcome measures. Serve as a subject matter expert and authoritative resource on interpretation and application of CDI practices, coding rules and regulations and conducts risk assessments of potential and detected compliance deficiencies, as well as documentation improvement opportunities. The position works closely with key stakeholders in Coding, Quality, Physician Champions, and others to ensure overall clinical documentation represents an accurate picture of the patient's hospital stay therefore confirming both internal and external reporting of information is accurate and complete. The CDI Director will collaborate extensively and in a collegial manner with the CDI Physician Advisors, Chief Medical Officers (CMO), Chief Quality Officers (CQO's) and other leaders in the review of complex patients. Actively participates on committees and presents the results of studies, trends, and activities as necessary to demonstrate improvement in the quality of clinical documentation. This position will create performance measures to assess the impact of clinical documentation targeted at the capture of the severity of illness of hospitalized patients. This position leads the collaborative efforts of cross-functional teams to minimize variation in clinical practice documentation.

Locations

Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • Provides CDI strategic direction for the program and collaborates with internal resources, consultants, auditors, electronic systems, and physician champions.
  • Works collaboratively with the service lines, Physician Leaders/Liaisons and other resources to clarify and/or otherwise improve documentation in order to accurately support diagnosis and quality indicators for care rendered to patients.
  • Develop CDI tools and queries, leads initiatives, and is a subject-matter expert in CDI, managing the hospital CDI team and leading efforts in educating medical staff and other clinicians in clinical documentation requirements.
  • Co leads the CDI Steering Committee
  • Creates, tracks, trends and reports on performance measures to assess the impact of clinical documentation improvement program. Routinely provide the medical staff with Key Performance Indicators related to their documentation and query response rates.
  • Develops and delivering training and education to clinical, CDI and coding professionals regarding CDI practices, coding and documentation requirements.
  • Leads multidisciplinary and cross departmental documentation initiatives to achieve strategic goals and objectives.
  • Coordinates and ensures the overall quality and completeness of medical record clinical documentation.
  • Connects and integrates internal and external resources to streamline systems and to effectively monitor and report outcomes.
  • Interacts with treating physicians and partners with Coding and Quality leadership for issue resolution and to ensure complete and compliant physician documentation supporting MS-DRG, APR-DGR, severity of illness, risk of mortality, and HAC clarifications with appropriate clinical groups.
  • Develops a meaningful scorecard, dashboard metrics, peer group comparisons, and service specific data that are actionable.
  • Designs and delivers service specific education for clinicians and directs CDI staff to deliver point of care education which focuses on accurate documentation of severity of illness and risk of mortality.
  • Develops processes and systems to identify projects that can demonstrate a return on efforts.
  • Implements tracking tools to benchmark against best practices, to maintain forward momentum and to establish timelines for actions.
  • Oversees the data analysis and reporting essential for project management and identification of improvement opportunities and action plans to achieve results.
  • Oversees the monitoring and evaluation of patient care in relationship to best practices while reviewing aggregate data and makes any relevant recommendations to modify/improve patient care and/or clinical documentation.
  • Maintains a system to monitor efforts and to analyze if desired goals are being achieved.
  • Designs concurrent clinical documentation review of CDI team members and ensures that there is appropriate physician interaction when ambiguous or conflicting information is in the medical record, providing guidance to Case Management, physicians, and hospital staff regarding documentation for correct coding and compliance necessary for increased Case Mix Index (CMI), decreased Length of Stay (LOS), and optimal resource utilization.

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in nursing, Health Information Management, or similarly related field of study. Master’s degree preferred.

Experience Qualifications

  • Seven (7) years of management experience required including five (5) years of CDI experience in an acute care setting.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced clinical expertise and extensive knowledge of complex disease processes with broad based clinical experience in an inpatient setting.
  • Demonstrated business communication skills with demonstrated leadership and influencing abilities and the ability to work and communicate effectively with physicians and other clinical professional staff.
  • Knowledge of care delivery documentation systems and related medical record documentation.
  • Proven track record of successfully implementing process improvements and achieving high-performance goals.
  • Displays skill in organizational savvy by adapting own approach to the audience, anticipating impact of words and actions, preparing for possible resistance, and responding in an appropriate style, using a range of influencing styles.
  • Outstanding relationship management skills – easily builds strong and effective working relationships within a climate of trust, inspires cooperation and confidence and is a true consensus builder.
  • A strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture and work at a high level with members of the executive team and physician leadership.
  • Must possess excellent oral and written communication skills and be able to communicate effectively with all levels of management.
  • Must have demonstrated interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills in dealing with multidisciplinary teams and variety of ongoing activities.
  • Ability to work with senior management, physicians, and medical center staff with various levels of education and experience.
  • Ability to develop and maintain strong, collaborative and supportive working relationships with CDI peers, physicians and other clinical professionals.
  • Demonstrated judgment and independent decision making.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and reporting practices pertaining to quality improvement and program evaluation.
  • Ability to lead teams and produce project results within schedule.
  • Knowledgeable and capable to apply/incorporate coding and clinical concepts into all phases of the development, instruction, and communication of the CDI Services.
  • Stays current with requirements of CMS Inpatient Prospective Payment Systems (IPPS), AHA Coding Clinic and ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting.
  • Expertise in MS-DRGs, ICD coding and CDI practices.
  • Expertise in MS-DRGs, ICD coding, CDI practices, and knowledge distribution to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Maintains working knowledge of Medicare/Medicaid rules and regulations regarding CDI, POA (present on admission), basic coding, as well as current trends and developments in the area of Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI).
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Skilled and experienced in data analysis and qualitative reporting of results.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of Medicare/Medicaid rules and regulations regarding CDI, POA, PSI, HAC, basic coding, as well as current trends and developments in the area of Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI).
  • Ability to direct data management and report generation activities.
  • Ability to manage, organize, prioritize, multi-task and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Demonstrated organizational, problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with medical staff and to foster effective working relationships and build consensus with others.
  • Ability to provide leadership and influence others, both directly and indirectly.
  • Ability to resolve complex problems and initiatives.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization and vendors.

Licenses and Certifications

  • CA-RN (Registered Nurse) . or
  • RHIA - Registered Health Information Administrator . or
  • CCDS - Cert Clinical Document Spec . or
  • CDIP – Clinical Documentation Improvement Practitioner . or
  • MD – Medical Doctor (foreign educated, acceptable; active or non-active license) .

These principles apply to ALL employees:

SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience

Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.

You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:


  • Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care
  • Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health
  • Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination

People of all genders, members of all racial and ethnic groups, people with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply. Qualified applicants with criminal convictions will be considered after an individualized assessment of the conviction and the job requirements.

The Acute Strategic Client Manager - Revenue Cycle will lead executive relationships (as an Individual Contributor) for top enterprise (Acute) clients, with deep expertise in Acute-basedrevenue cycle management services and accountability for value realization across the broader TruBridge portfolio, including the EHR and third-party solutions. The SCM will use revenue cycle leadership experience to improve operational and financial performance while advancing EHR adoption, solution integration, and overall client outcomes.


This role is NOT a leadership position, rather it owns client-specific success and recovery plans, drives measurable improvements across the revenue cycle and broader solution portfolio, coordinates cross-functional execution, manages escalations and risk, supports retention and growth, and ensures clients can demonstrate value from the TruBridge partnership.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop and implement client success plans with defined retention, satisfaction, risk-reduction, and growth objectives.
  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of each client’s organization and healthcare environment to strengthen strategic relationships and advance documented client outcomes.
  • Measure client satisfaction and engagement through structured feedback, executive conversations, solution adoption, service performance, and relationship indicators.
  • Create and maintain value realization reporting that demonstrates client ROI, supports executive business reviews, identifies satisfaction or adoption gaps, strengthens renewal decisions, and informs responsible growth opportunities.
  • Align qualified clients with the TruBridge reference program.
  • Own executive-level performance reviews with client financial and operational leaders, translating revenue cycle data into prioritized actions that improve cash collections, accounts receivable performance, denial outcomes, billing effectiveness, and overall financial health.
  • Lead cross-functional TruBridge Financial Health teams and subject matter experts in diagnosing client performance challenges, establishing corrective action plans, assigning clear ownership, removing barriers, and holding internal and client stakeholders accountable for timely execution and measurable results.

These goals and objectives are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed; employees will be required to work dynamically within a team structure and perform other job-related duties as required. Goals and objectives are subject to change.


All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA, and other regulations, as appropriate.


Essential Functions: In addition to working as prescribed in our performance factors specific responsibilities of this role include:


  • Proven ability to build and maintain complex client relationships, including strategic partnerships with C-suite leaders and stakeholders across client organizations.
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end healthcare revenue cycle operations, including patient access, charge capture, coding, billing, claims management, denials, accounts receivable, cash collections, underpayments, write-offs, and payer or contractual performance.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience in managing operational processes and driving growth strategies.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple client priorities, focusing on common results.
  • Highly organized and efficient in time management.
  • Connected to all life cycles of client relationships, including sales, implementation, and support.
  • Develop and establish best practices for client profitability management, including invoicing, accounts receivable, cash collections, write-off processes, and contractual interactions.
  • Serve as the executive escalation point for material RCM service and performance issues, rapidly assess business impact, mobilize the appropriate operational leaders and subject matter experts, establish recovery milestones, and communicate progress through resolution.
  • Own the client relationship and overall execution for assigned clients, with direct accountability for retention, renewal readiness, client satisfaction, risk reduction, and responsible growth.
  • Maintain a disciplined client risk management process using service, financial, operational, relationship, and contractual indicators; identify emerging risks early; quantify retention and financial exposure; establish mitigation plans with accountable owners and deadlines; and escalate unresolved risks through measurable resolution.
  • Identify and qualify expansion opportunities, including appropriate upsell or cross-sell options, based on client priorities, adoption, performance, and demonstrated value; partner with sales to reach mutually beneficial agreements that protect trust, retention, and long-term growth.
  • Team-oriented, focusing on constructive feedback, process improvement, and developing best practices.

Minimum Requirements:

Education/Experience/Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field (preferred).
  • Ability to travel up to 30%-40% regionally
  • At least 7 years of Acute healthcare revenue cycle experience, including at least 3 years leading client-facing RCM services, operations, performance improvement, or complex account recovery initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience improving Acute-based revenue cycle performance, with working knowledge of key measures such as cash collections, accounts receivable aging, denial performance, billing quality, and payer or contractual outcomes.
  • Proven success improving client satisfaction, protecting renewals, reducing preventable attrition, and recovering at-risk client relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify emerging client issues, establish clear resolution plans, maintain accountability across stakeholders, and follow through until risk is mitigated and the client confirms an acceptable outcome.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively, engaging the appropriate subject matter experts to resolve client needs and achieve shared outcomes.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to listen and connect the dots for client benefit.
  • Experience advising and influencing hospital CFOs, revenue cycle executives, and operational leaders on performance gaps, competing priorities, recovery plans, and financial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze revenue cycle performance trends, identify root causes of underperformance, quantify financial impact, and present clear recommendations and accountable recovery plans to client and internal leaders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in strategic account management, healthcare technology, or health information systems that complements the required healthcare revenue cycle leadership background.

Imagine yourself…

  • Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
  • Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project.
  • Collaborating with a vibrant, inclusive, global team.
  • Joining a company with a proven track record of success and an exciting future.

At Hach, a Veralto company, we ensure water quality for people around the world, and every team member plays a vital role in that mission. Our founding vision is to make water analysis better—faster, simpler, greener, and more informative. We accomplish this through teamwork, customer partnerships, passionate experts, and reliable, easy-to-use solutions.


As part of our team and the broader Veralto network, you'll be part of a unique work environment where purpose meets possibility: where you'll make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale by enabling the world's everyday water needs, and where you'll have opportunities to foster your professional development and fuel your career growth.


Motivated by the highest possible stakes in climate change and global health, we're working together within a rapidly digitizing industry to find innovative technologies that guarantee the safety of our water and our environment. More about us:


We offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Professional onboarding and training opportunities
  • Career coaching and development programs
  • Collaborative and supportive international team environment
  • Comprehensive health and wellbeing benefits
  • Opportunities for growth within a global organization

About the role

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations & Incentive Compensation, the Variable Compensation Analyst is responsible for administering and optimizing Hach's variable compensation programs across the European sales organization. This role serves as the system owner and subject matter expert for commission operations, ensuring accurate and compliant incentive processing while driving continuous improvement through data analysis and system enhancements. The successful candidate will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Finance, and Sales Enablement teams to deliver actionable insights, improve compensation processes, and support strategic business objectives.

This position is part of the Sales Operations organization and will be remote within APAC, with a strong preference for candidates based in Indonesia.


In this role, a typical day will look like

  • Administer the end-to-end variable compensation process, including commission calculations, payouts, adjustments, quota management, and case resolution.
  • Own and optimize the Oracle Fusion Incentive Compensation (FIC) platform, including system configuration, governance, enhancements, and long-term roadmap planning.
  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for commission processing and incentive plan administration, providing guidance to stakeholders across the business.
  • Analyze commission-related inquiries and system performance data to identify trends, resolve root causes, and implement process improvements.
  • Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to evaluate compensation plan effectiveness and recommend data-driven enhancements.
  • Support commission forecasting, accruals, and financial planning activities through collaboration with Finance teams.
  • Ensure compliance with SOX requirements, internal controls, and audit standards while supporting internal and external audits.
  • Develop reporting and analytical insights that help leadership assess compensation program performance and align incentives with business goals.

The essential requirements of the job include

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in compensation, commissions administration, revenue operations, FP&A, sales operations, or a related analytical business function.
  • Experience administering variable compensation or incentive programs, including commission calculations and payment processes.
  • Hands-on experience with incentive compensation systems or enterprise commission management platforms.
  • Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with large datasets.
  • Experience using business intelligence or data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, compliance requirements, and process governance within a business environment.

About Hach & Veralto

Hach is proud to be part of the Water Quality segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we're Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

raw.excerpt: About Kinaxis Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career?
raw.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Canada or ouroffice in Ottawa, Canada.

About the team

The AI Security Governance Analyst operationalizes approved AI security policies, standards and governance processes within Security Strategy & Compliance. The role performs and coordinates AI cybersecurity assessments, evaluates control evidence, identifies risks and deficiencies, maintains traceable records, and produces decision-ready reporting. The analyst applies approved frameworks and procedures, recommends proportionate treatment, and escalates decisions outside the role’s authority. The role uses approved AI-enabled tools to improve workflow efficiency, evidence management, analysis and reporting. Human review, validation, transparency, confidentiality and accountability remain required.

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy

What you will do

AI Security Governance and Lifecycle

  • Apply Kinaxis AI policy, security standards, guardrails and playbooks in Corporate IT and security-managed environments; maintain an implementation register covering owners, requirements, controls, evidence, status, exceptions and review dates.
  • Maintain authoritative AI security governance, assessment and assurance records for in-scope AI systems, generative AI, agents, pilots and material AI features; reconcile records with inventories owned by Corporate IT, Product or other designated owners.
  • Validate intake information, including ownership, purpose, data use, deployment context, architecture, vendor, integrations, human oversight and lifecycle state; identify reassessment triggers and track use cases through intake, assessment, authorization, review, suspension and retirement.
  • Escalate incomplete intake, unclear ownership, unregistered AI, material changes, unsupported exceptions and overdue remediation through established channels.

AI Security Assessment and Action Tracking

  • Perform or coordinate AI cybersecurity assessments using approved methods and criteria, including assessments of generative and agentic AI, non-human identities, privileged access, APIs, integrations, secrets, sensitive data, human oversight and secure-lifecycle controls.
  • Evaluate security inputs, threat models and architecture evidence for trust boundaries, attack paths, data flows, agent capabilities, permissions, autonomy, approval gates, observability, controllability and potential blast radius, using guidance such as MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM and agentic AI security resources.
  • Identify threats, vulnerabilities, misuse scenarios, control gaps and inherent or residual cybersecurity exposure; document findings, required controls, accountable owners, remediation, exceptions, compensating controls and reassessment triggers.
  • Recommend proportionate cybersecurity treatment and track actions to verified closure, approved exception or formal escalation. Risk-treatment and acceptance decisions remain with authorized risk owners and governance bodies.

Control Assurance, Metrics and Reporting

  • Translate approved AI security requirements into control and evidence expectations covering lifecycle gates, identities, privileged access, APIs, credentials, sensitive data, human oversight, logging, monitoring, and generative or agentic AI.
  • Evaluate control design, implementation and relevant testing evidence, including threat modelling, adversarial testing, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and security-relevant TEVV. Document limitations, conclusions, deficiencies and outstanding evidence needs.
  • Assess whether logging, telemetry, monitoring and detection capabilities are proportionate to cybersecurity risk; verify implementation evidence and escalate material or persistent gaps.
  • Maintain dashboards and audit-ready records covering intake, assessments, cybersecurity classification, control coverage, findings, remediation, exceptions and emerging themes. Maintain mappings supporting ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST SP 800-53 and other assigned requirements.
  • Analyze AI-related security incidents and lessons learned from a governance and assurance perspective and incorporate relevant findings into assessments, controls and reassessment criteria.
  • Maintains current knowledge of rapid developments in AI, particularly generative and agentic AI, and their cybersecurity implications.

Third-Party AI and Awareness

  • Coordinate with Cybersecurity Risk and the third-party risk process to support appropriate review of AI vendors and AI-enabled supplier capabilities; provide documented security requirements, findings and evidence-based risk input.
  • Publish practical AI security guidance and support role-based awareness on intake triggers, sensitive-data handling, credential protection, human oversight, approved use and incident escalation.

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Risk Management, Business, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent education and professional experience.
  • Professional experience in AI security governance, cybersecurity governance, technology risk, security compliance, security audit, Corporate IT governance or security program delivery.
  • Experience operationalizing policies, risk assessments, control requirements, workflows, reporting and assurance evidence, including cross-functional assessment and action tracking.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise AI lifecycles and security risks affecting generative and agentic AI, identities, privileged access, APIs, integrations, secrets, sensitive data, human oversight, logging and monitoring.
  • Ability to evaluate control evidence, identify deficiencies, distinguish inherent from residual exposure, produce defensible findings, and communicate decision-ready summaries without assuming control-operation or risk-acceptance authority.
  • Strong written communication, analytical judgment, organization and stakeholder coordination skills; experience with GRC, workflow, ticketing, inventory, document-management or reporting tools.

Preffered Qualifications

  • Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST SP 800-53, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience with AI supplier review, secure deployment patterns, control mappings, dashboards, evidence or executive reporting.
  • AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Foundation, ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation, Security+, CGRC or a comparable credential is an asset.

Associate - #Associate

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at

On top of a competitive salary, you’ll receive 22 days paid time off, plus 11 company paid holidays. Also, medical, dental & vision insurance, 5% 401(k) company match, plus a range of other benefits that you can choose from.

raw.description:
About PatientIQ

PatientIQ is a fast-growing health tech company on a mission to improve patient outcomes. We partner with healthcare providers, medical device companies, and researchers to collect, analyze, and act on patient-reported outcomes data at scale — powering smarter clinical decisions and accelerating the future of value-based care.

Headquartered in Chicago and backed by top-tier venture capital and major health system investors, PatientIQ is building the largest platform for healthcare providers, industry partners, and researchers to collaborate on what matters most: helping patients get better.

The opportunity

PatientIQ partners with health systems, medical device companies, and researchers to turn patient-reported outcomes into better patient care. As our Senior Director, Integrated Marketing, you'll make that customer base our strongest growth engine, driving expansion and upsell pipeline through account-based campaigns, customer advocacy, and a reference program that gives Sales credible proof when it matters most.

You'll also lead our event strategy across third-party and PatientIQ-hosted events, with clear accountability for the pipeline those events source and influence. You'll own customer marketing for our Strategic and Tier 2 customers, working side by side with Customer Success, Sales, and Product to understand what customers need and how we can serve them better.

You'll thrive here if you're comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder buying committees and the long, relationship-driven sales cycles typical of enterprise healthcare.

What you'll do

Customer Insights and Segmentation:

  • Analyze customer and usage data to identify trends, segment the customer base, and develop customer personas that inform targeted expansion and retention strategies for Strategic and Tier 2 accounts.

Campaign Development and Execution:

  • Lead the design and execution of customer-centric campaigns across email, social media, digital advertising, and events that drive adoption, upsell, and cross-sell, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.
  • Design and run account-based marketing programs for Strategic and Tier 2 customers, in partnership with Sales and Customer Success, to deepen adoption and open conversations with new stakeholders.

Customer Lifecycle Management:

  • Create tailored programs that engage customers from onboarding through renewal and expansion, partnering with Customer Success and Sales to surface and accelerate expansion pipeline.

Advocacy:

  • Build and scale a customer advocacy and reference program, including case studies, testimonials, customer references, customer speakers, and peer review and analyst relations, that supports sales and strengthens customer loyalty.

Event Strategy and Execution:

  • Own the strategy, planning, and execution of third-party and PatientIQ-hosted events, from industry conferences to customer and executive gatherings, to generate pipeline and deepen customer relationships.
  • Own event-sourced and event-influenced pipeline targets and attribution, evaluate third-party sponsorships against cost-per-opportunity goals, and make a clear business case for event spend.

Metrics and Reporting:

  • Define and track KPIs for customer engagement, retention, net revenue retention contribution, expansion pipeline (sourced and influenced), reference availability, lifetime value, and event ROI, and use data to make adjustments that optimize results.

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing to deliver a seamless customer experience and align customer marketing with broader business goals.

Budget Management:

  • Oversee the customer and event marketing budget, allocating funds effectively across initiatives and ensuring ROI.

What success looks like

We believe clarity drives performance. Here's what the first 90 days look like in this role:

30 days - Ramped on PatientIQ's products, customers, and messaging; met with Customer Success, Sales, and key customers; audit of current customer marketing, advocacy, and event programs complete; initial segmentation of Strategic and Tier 2 accounts drafted.

60 days - Customer marketing and event strategy aligned with the Head of Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success; first expansion and account-based campaigns in market; reference program framework and first advocacy assets (case studies, references) underway; event calendar, budget, and pipeline targets set.

90 days - Expansion pipeline (sourced and influenced), event, and reference program KPIs defined and reported on a regular cadence; campaigns and events refined based on early results; clear handoff process with Customer Success and AEs for expansion opportunities.

Requirements

What you bring

Required

  • Proven ability to define strategy, drive alignment, and lead end-to-end execution of customer marketing initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in customer marketing, expansion pipeline growth, account-based marketing, advocacy and reference programs, case studies, and third-party and PatientIQ-hosted events.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer data and apply insights to segmentation, targeting, campaign strategy, and pipeline attribution.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing customer marketing campaigns that drive measurable growth.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills to influence cross-functional teams and convey customer insights.
  • Skilled in marketing automation tools and CRM systems.
  • Experienced leader with a track record of managing and motivating high-performing teams with diverse goals.

Nice to have

  • Experience in US B2B SaaS healthcare technology, ideally marketing to health systems, medical device companies, or research organizations.

Benefits

Why PatientIQ

  • Mission-driven work. We're solving a hard problem that matters — improving patient outcomes through better data. Every person here is working on something real.
  • True idea meritocracy. Great ideas win, regardless of title. We encourage every team member to challenge the status quo.
  • World-class team. You'll work alongside people who are at the top of their fields in health tech, enterprise software, and clinical science.
  • Fast-growing. We're building the largest platform for healthcare providers and industry to collaborate — and we're just getting started.
  • Great benefits. Top-notch health, dental, and vision. 401(k). Flexible PTO — we trust you to take the time you need. Professional development stipends.
  • Real ownership. This is not a role where you maintain someone else's playbook. You'll build, shape strategy, and see your impact directly.

Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the diagnostic loop for LLM-based clinical services: take failure modes surfaced by clinical reviewers and product managers, form root-cause hypotheses (prompt design, context assembly, retrieval, guideline encoding, model behavior, upstream data), and design experiments that isolate the cause.
  • Test candidate fixes — prompt and configuration variants, context changes, model alternatives — and verify improvements with structured evaluations, not anecdotes; confirm fixes don't regress other behavior.
  • Own the evaluation roadmap and quality bar for the team's AI services: which metrics gate deployment, how golden sets and regression suites grow, and what "good enough to ship" means in evidence.
  • Use and extend the team's evaluation platform: build golden sets and regression suites, define metrics (accuracy, guideline adherence, grounding/faithfulness), run and interpret eval batteries. Fluency in *using* modern eval tooling matters; the platform exists — extending it thoughtfully is in scope, rebuilding it is not.
  • Partner with clinical reviewers (medical directors) to turn review findings into labeled evidence and executable evaluation criteria; partner with product managers to prioritize which failure modes matter most.
  • Mentor others in evaluation methods and grow the evals function as it scales, including readiness to take direct reports as the team expands.
  • Support the annual clinical-guidelines update cycle with regression evaluation as guidelines, prompts, and models change; ramp with the team's senior data scientists in Q4 2026.
  • Document the diagnostic playbook: failure taxonomies, experiment templates, variant history — a method others can run, not a private intuition. This is a practicing role — the diagnostic loop is the job, at every level of seniority.
  • Handle clinical data (including PHI) according to organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of data science or applied machine learning experience, including shipping and maintaining models or AI systems in production.
  • 2+ years of recent, hands-on experience evaluating and improving LLM-based systems: structured error analysis, prompt/configuration iteration, experiment design, metrics interpretation — as a practitioner, not only as a reviewer of others' work.
  • Demonstrated experience with LLM evaluation methods and tools — golden/regression sets, LLM-as-judge with validation, tracing and observability tooling.
  • Strong Python and solid data-analysis skills (SQL a plus); comfort computing and reasoning about metrics such as sensitivity, specificity, and PPV.
  • Hypothesis-driven working style: the instinct to isolate variables and prove a fix, rather than tweak and hope.
  • Strong written communication — findings and go/no-go evidence must be legible to engineers, clinicians, and leadership.

Preferred Requirements

  • Healthcare experience: utilization management, prior authorization, clinical documentation, or clinical/claims data; comfort reading clinical guideline and medical-policy content.
  • Experience mentoring data scientists or leading small technical workstreams; interest in growing into people leadership as a function scales.
  • Experience working with clinical reviewers or other domain experts to convert expert judgment into labeled data and evaluation criteria.
  • Experience with LLM observability/telemetry stacks (OpenTelemetry-based tracing, Logfire, Langfuse, or similar).
  • Statistics or experimentation background (A/B testing, statistical significance, sample-size reasoning).
  • Master's degree in a quantitative field.

We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with strong hands-on experience in deploying, debugging, and optimizing training and inference workloads on large-scale GPU clusters. As we support customers and partners across Europe in training models on ground breaking GPU infrastructure, we are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges at the intersection of High Performance Computing and AI. Similarly, inference is increasing in its complexity with explosion of MOE models and disaggregated execution making inference truly a HPC workload. You don’t need to have expertise in every skill we mention, but we are especially interested in candidates who bring deep knowledge in at least few key areas to enable large scale AI workloads. If you can demonstrate hands-on experience, we would love to hear from you.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Collaborating with NVIDIA’s training framework developers and product teams to stay ahead of the latest features and help partners to adopt them effectively.

  • Assisting with deployment, debugging, and improving the efficiency of AI workloads on extensive NVIDIA platforms.

  • Benchmarking new framework features, analyzing performance, and sharing actionable insights with both customers and internal teams.

  • Working directly with external customers to solve cluster performance and stability issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement effective solutions.

  • Build expertise and guide customers in scaling workloads efficiently and reliably on the latest generation of NVIDIA GPUs.

  • Contributing to Europe’s Sovereign AI initiative by helping customers implement advanced resiliency features within AI training pipelines.

What We Need To See:

  • BS, MS, PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related engineering field—or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in accelerated computing technologies at cluster scale, ideally including work with NVIDIA platforms.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of the following languages: C, C++, or Python.

  • Practical experience identifying and resolving bottlenecks in large-scale training workloads or parallel applications.

  • Hands-on experienced in profiling and debugging large parallel applications.

  • Solid understanding of CPU and GPU architectures, CUDA, parallel filesystems, and high-speed interconnects.

  • Experienced in working with large compute clusters with an understanding of their internal scheduling and resource management mechanisms (e.g. SLURM or Cloud based clusters).

  • Proficient knowledge of training pipelines and frameworks, encompassing their internal operations and performance attributes.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Experience in debugging training pipelines running on thousands of GPUs in production environment.

  • Hands-on experience with performance profiling and optimizations using tools like Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute and good understanding of NCCL, MPI and low-level communication libraries.

  • Ability to debug stability issues across the entire stack: parallel application, training frameworks, runtime libraries, schedulers, and hardware.

  • Solid understanding of the internal workings of LLM frameworks such as PyTorch, Megatron-LM, or NeMo, and how they affect compute layers like CPUs, GPUs, network and storage or understanding of inference tools such as vLLM, Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, RedHat Inference Server or SGLang.

You'll be credible discussing property operations and investment strategy with a client's leadership, guiding the solution alongside their data and engineering teams, and representing Cherre in front of a prospect's decision-makers. Domain fluency is the foundation; the ideal candidate pairs it with enough technical depth and executive presence to carry a solution from discovery through the deal.This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll be in the room for our most strategic deals, shaping how we translate complex prospect requirements into compelling, credible solutions. Just as important, you'll be expected to modernize how the function operates. We want a leader who builds tools and AI-assisted workflows that make the team faster and sharper, not one who simply runs the existing playbook.

  • Lead the domain engine. Understand each client’s business deeply and align solutions to achieve their objectives.
  • Lead the presales function. Own the full presales lifecycle and partner closely with Sales to drive technical wins on strategic and enterprise opportunities.
  • Manage and develop the team. Hire, coach, and grow a team of Solution Architects and Business Analysts. Set standards, build expertise, balance workloads across active deals, and foster a culture of technical rigor.
  • Drive scoping and discovery. Personally lead scoping and discovery for strategic prospects, uncovering requirements, identifying risks, and defining solutions that map to real business outcomes.
  • Own the RFP process. Run the RFP response process end to end, ensuring responses are accurate, differentiated, and delivered on time.
  • Ensure clean handoffs to Delivery. Build and maintain a repeatable bridge from presales scoping into implementation so nothing is lost between the sale and the build.
  • Modernize the function with AI. Design and build skills and agentic workflows, and optimize the agentic fleet to streamline the process from scoping through delivery. Continuously identify ways to use AI to improve the quality and speed of the team’s output.
  • Represent the point of view. Publish, speak, and advocate for Cherre’s perspective on real assets data and semantic infrastructure, shaping how the market thinks about the problem—not just how Cherre solves it.
  • Close the loop into Product. Translate market and client signals from the field into product roadmap input, ensuring the roadmap reflects what the market is actually telling you—not just what has already been scoped.

Qualifications

  • Real assets domain expertise spanning the full stack: up into the capital stack (fund structures, debt and equity vehicles, investment vehicles) and down into the physical, operational asset (property operations, leasing, maintenance, tenant and resident experience). A track record of scoping and designing solutions that hold together across both ends of that stack, not just one.
  • Global and cross-asset-class experience: comfortable moving between multifamily, office, industrial, retail, and alternative asset classes, and across US, European, and APAC market conventions and regulatory contexts.- 10+ years in real estate, proptech, or consulting, with experience leading teams of domain and technical experts.
  • Technical fluency across entity resolution, graph-based data models, and semantic layer architecture, sufficient to guide solution and demo design and engage credibly with a client's data and engineering teams on how identity, confidence, and lineage actually work under the platform, not just what the platform outputs.
  • Fluent in the shift from human-readable reporting to typed, governed interfaces built for agent consumption: why a report could tolerate semantic drift that an agent reasoning from the same data cannot, and why that difference is now a product architecture problem, not a documentation problem.
  • Demonstrated thought leadership: a track record of publishing or speaking on real assets, data, or investment strategy, not just executing someone else's narrative.
  • Executive presence to represent Cherre externally, lead the room in strategic deals, and translate technical complexity into business value for institutional buyers.
  • The ability to operate as both a player and a coach: both getting hands-on in deals, and effective at hiring, developing, and leading a high-performing team behind you.
  • An AI-forward mindset, with hands-on experience building tools, automations, or agentic workflows.

  • Building AI agents and agentic workflows

raw.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

What You'll Do:

The Strategic Customer Success Data Analyst plays a key client-facing role, partnering with high-value accounts to uncover needs, define strategies, and deliver data-driven solutions that support business goals. This role leverages analytics, reporting, and visualization tools to monitor program health, track user adoption, and identify risks or opportunities that impact account performance and retention. Serving as a liaison between clients and internal teams, the analyst ensures service excellence by managing service center requests, analyzing key data points, and delivering clear, actionable insights through frequent, professional communication. Proven ability to adopt new technologies quickly, uphold SLAs and CSAT standards, and build lasting client relationships is essential to success in this role.

This is a 100% remote position, individual must be open to occasional travel and is required to be in United States.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor service levels, client satisfaction, and activity to proactively identify issues or opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain complex reports and dashboards using Excel, Power BI, Salesforce, and internal systems.
  • Identify data quality issues, recommend corrective actions, and ensure data integrity.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support new solutions and provide technical support.
  • Prepare and present analytical insights for Quarterly Business Reviews and other client-specific analyses.
  • Work closely with development and project teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Manage data integration solutions, ensuring efficient extraction, transformation, and loading of data.
  • Build and nurture relationships with account representatives at all levels to ensure seamless communication.
  • Conduct root cause analysis on contact drivers to prioritize optimization opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain client-specific SOPs, process documentation, and workflows.
  • Escalate operational and technical issues to internal teams to resolve billing, technology, or operational challenges.
  • Test product enhancements or features to ensure successful implementation for client programs.
  • Partner with Directors to strengthen relationships and drive client success.
  • Perform research and analysis for both internal and external stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Ensure timely resolution of service tickets and monitor ticket progress for closure.
  • Verify billing accuracy, identify discrepancies, and recommend solutions for any invoicing issues.
  • Track and report on trends to inform regular account reviews.
  • Keep client fact sheets updated and relevant to reflect changing needs.
  • Gather customer feedback and make recommendations to enhance products and services.
  • Provide training and create job aids for both departmental and customer needs.
  • Address and resolve customer escalations promptly.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management to support team and client objectives.

  • High School diploma or GED equivalent required; 4+ years of experience in customer support, data analytics, or a related field.
  • Proven expertise in data analysis, reporting, and customer success, with 2-4 years of experience in an analytics/reporting role.
  • Strong proficiency in MS Excel, MS Teams, and Salesforce CRM; experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools is a plus.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex data in a clear, actionable, and insightful manner.
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment, adapting to rapid changes and multiple priorities.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks.
  • Occasional travel to customer sites may be required to support customer success outreach.

Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move:

First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.
Additional benefits offered to our eligible people include:

  • Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans
  • 401k with an employer match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays
  • Access to tech and growth opportunities, and leaders who want you to succeed!

raw.description:
About Relish

At Relish, we're transforming the way businesses manage their supplier relationships, third-party risk, and procurement processes.

Our AI-powered solutions help organizations simplify supplier data validation, streamline invoicing, and get more value from their enterprise technology investments. Trusted by hundreds of global organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we're helping businesses work smarter, reduce risk, and unlock new opportunities.

We're growing, and we're looking for commercially minded Account Executives who know how to turn strong customer relationships into meaningful business growth.

The Opportunity

We're hiring two Account Executives – Customer Base to join our growing sales organisation.

Unlike traditional new business sales roles, this opportunity is all about growing the relationships we already have. You'll work with an established portfolio of customers, identifying opportunities to expand their use of Relish's solutions, introduce additional products, and drive long-term revenue growth.

You'll be responsible for uncovering opportunities, building relationships with new stakeholders within existing accounts, and leading commercial conversations that deliver value for both our customers and Relish.

We're hiring across two key technology channels:

  • SAP: One Account Executive focused on expanding relationships within our SAP customer base.

  • Workday / Coupa: One Account Executive focused on customers operating within the Workday OR Coupa ecosystems.

Experience within SAP, Workday, or Coupa is certainly an advantage, but it's not essential. What matters most is your ability to grow existing accounts, build trusted relationships, and consistently deliver commercial results.

You'll work closely with our Customer Success team, who focus on customer satisfaction and adoption, while you take ownership of identifying and closing opportunities for additional revenue.

If you're someone who enjoys building relationships, spotting untapped potential, and turning customer conversations into commercial wins, this could be a great fit.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Grow existing accounts: Own and execute account expansion strategies, identifying opportunities to increase revenue through upselling and cross-selling.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Develop strong partnerships with existing customers, engaging stakeholders across Procurement, Accounts Payable, IT, and executive leadership.

  • Uncover new opportunities: Proactively identify additional business units, departments, and decision-makers within existing customer accounts.

  • Drive commercial conversations: Lead discovery, proposals, negotiations, and closing activities for expansion opportunities.

  • Expand product adoption: Identify opportunities to introduce complementary Relish solutions across supplier management, third-party risk, data validation, and invoicing.

  • Partner with Customer Success: Work closely with our CSM team to understand customer needs, identify growth opportunities, and support long-term customer value.

  • Own your pipeline: Build and manage a healthy pipeline of expansion, cross-sell, and renewal opportunities, maintaining accurate forecasts and CRM records.

  • Deliver results: Consistently achieve or exceed revenue targets while contributing to a collaborative, high-performing sales team.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who knows that the best commercial opportunities don't always come from winning new customers - sometimes they're sitting within the relationships you've already built.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of B2B software or SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of growing revenue within an existing customer base.

  • Demonstrated success in account expansion, upselling, cross-selling, or strategic account management.

  • A consistent history of achieving or exceeding sales targets.

  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles and navigating multiple stakeholders.

  • The confidence to engage senior decision-makers, uncover business challenges, and position solutions that deliver measurable value.

  • A proactive, commercially curious mindset — you're not waiting for customers to ask for more; you're identifying opportunities before they do.

  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills.

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Customer Success and other internal teams.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience selling into Procurement, Finance, Accounts Payable, or IT stakeholders.

  • Exposure to SAP, Workday, or Coupa ecosystems.

  • Experience selling multiple products or solutions into enterprise customer accounts.

  • An understanding of supplier management, procurement technology, or Source-to-Pay processes.

Please note: This role involves approximately 15–30% travel.

Why Join Relish?

  • An established customer base: Focus on expanding relationships and uncovering opportunities within customers who already know our solutions.

  • Real commercial ownership: Take responsibility for driving account growth and directly influencing revenue.

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere in the United States.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, and flexible time away.

  • The tools to succeed: Access to leading enterprise software, AI tools, and a company-provided laptop.

  • A collaborative culture: Work alongside talented colleagues who value teamwork, trust, and doing the right thing.

Ready to Grow With Us?

If you're a relationship-driven Account Executive who loves uncovering commercial opportunities, expanding customer partnerships, and making a measurable impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Whether your background is in SAP, Workday, Coupa, or broader enterprise SaaS, we're interested in what you can bring to the team.

Apply today and help us unlock the next stage of growth at Relish.

Relish is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds.

Du denkst in zusammenhängenden System, steuerst komplexe Organisationen und sorgst dafür, dass strategische Konzepte nicht auf Folien bleiben, sondern im Tagesgeschäft gelebt werden?

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE trägst du umfassende Verantwortung für Strukturen, Systeme und Teams.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE Digital verantwortest du die operative Steuerung in der Organisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens im operativen Tagesgeschäft wirksam wird. In deinem täglichen Handeln führst du die Organisation durch Phasen von Wachstum und Veränderung. Entwickelst Strukturen, Systeme und Abteilungen weiter und stellst sicher, dass EVOLVE als ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner reibungslos funktioniert - anstatt in Silos zu arbeiten.

Um eine zukunftsträchtige Agentur zu gestalten, nutzt du KI und Automationen gezielt als Wachstumshebel. Du definierst die operative System- und Automationsarchitektur und sorgst dafür, dass Technologie messbar zur Skalierung, Qualitätssicherung und Entlastung der Teams beiträgt.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung triffst du operative Grundsatzentscheidungen, setzt Prioritäten und schaffst die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass das EVOLVE planbar, effizient und zukunftsfähig wachsen kann.

Über EVOLVE Digital

EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse.

EVOLVE Digital bietet dir ein Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem Team aus 20+ erfahrenen Spezialisten.

Es ist ein Umfeld für Führungspersönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Komplexität beherrschen und Organisationen nachhaltig auf Skalierung ausrichten wollen.

Deine Aufgaben im Überblick

Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran.

  • Denn die besten Prozesse bringen nichts, wenn niemand nachhält, ob sie greifen. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

    Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du übersetzt die Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass das EVOLVE OS als ganzheitliches System und Kern unserer Dienstleistung funktioniert und sich fortlaufend weiterentwickelt

  • Du steuerst die operativen Abläufe vor allem innerhalb der Agentur und bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen über Onboarding.

  • Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten, wo sie benötigt und sinnvoll sind.

  • Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Für die Umsetzung stellen wir dir ein Team zur Verfügung.

  • Du betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag: Reminder, Check-ins, Dashboards. Ziele, die niemand nachhält, bleiben.

  • Zusammen mit den Teamleads gehst du Bottlenecks im Tagesgeschäft durch und löst sie an der Wurzel, nicht mit einem Pflaster.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projekt- und Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.

  • Du kennst dich mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana aus und verstehst in den Grundzügen Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n.

  • Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt.

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, da wir 100 % remote arbeiten.

  • Klare, strukturierte Kommunikation nach innen und außen. Du arbeitest mit Team Leads auf Augenhöhe an ihren Prozessen, ohne sie disziplinarisch zu führen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google-Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen.

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und Co. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur ,um Texte zu erstellen.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive Richtung Head of Operations

  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit

  • Attraktives Gehalt und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Umfangreiches Benefitprogramm, einschließlich einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiterbenefits, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz und eine langfristige Perspektive mit der Möglichkeit, sich zum COO weiterzuentwickeln

  • Kollegiale und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und offener Feedbackkultur

  • Umfangreiche fachliche Fortbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Moderne Arbeitsgeräte, inklusive Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertigem Zubehör für das Homeoffice.

  • 2x jährlich stattfindende Teamevents / Workations

Nächste Schritte & Ansprechpartner

Ansprechpartner: Dein erster Kontakt ist Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin und sie freut sich schon darauf dich kennen zu lernen.

So wirst du Teil unseres Teams: Du willst Teil unseres Teams werden? Dann bewirb dich jetzt direkt. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

raw.title: Head of AI Expansion
raw.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking a highly driven Head of AI Expansion to lead the global adoption of Tether’s AI ecosystem, with a focus on QVAC and decentralized, privacy-preserving AI infrastructure.

The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.

The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

International travel is required.

Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Drive global adoption of QVAC and Tether AI across enterprises, institutions, and governments.

  • Identify organizations where local, private, decentralized, or sovereign AI provides a strategic advantage.

  • Match use cases with needs of identified organizations and build business cases for the implementation of the use case

  • Nurture existing and build new relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, AI leaders, and government stakeholders.

  • Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close strategic AI partnerships and deployments.

  • Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem, including compute, hardware, infrastructure, and technology providers.

  • Monitor performance of partnerships, proactively identify risks and design mitigation plans

Market Strategy & Execution

  • Define and execute Tether AI’s global go-to-market strategy.

  • Identify priority markets, industries, and high-value AI use cases.

  • Co-develop with clients their requirements and translate them into deployable solutions together with product and engineering teams.

  • Build and manage a global pipeline of strategic AI opportunities.

  • Monitor market, competitive, regulatory, and technological developments.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead the AI Expansion team globally.

  • Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.

  • Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.

  • Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.

Strategic Representation

  • Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations seeking AI sovereignty, privacy, resilience, and infrastructure independence.

  • Represent Tether AI in strategic meetings, government engagements, conferences, and industry forums.

Requirements

You Have

  • 7+ years of experience across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, or technology business development.

  • Strong knowledge of AI/ML, LLMs, inference, local/edge computing, data infrastructure, and decentralized architectures.

  • Proven experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large enterprise technology deals and partnerships.

  • Strong relationships with senior decision-makers across enterprises, technology companies, and/or governments.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience building and managing high-performing teams.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate independently in fast-moving environments.

  • Degree in AI, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
