raw.title: Senior Statistician, Center for Vaccine Innovation and Access
raw.excerpt: PATH current employees - please log in and apply Here PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity.
raw.description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply Here

PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.


PATH’s Center for Vaccine Innovation and Access (CVIA) brings together our expertise across every stage of the long and complex process of vaccine research, development, and delivery to make lifesaving vaccines widely available to children and communities across the world. CVIA’s current portfolio encompasses more than two dozen vaccines either in development or already in use to protect against fifteen different diseases. Our focus is on vaccines to address the leading diseases that claim children’s lives worldwide: pneumonia, diarrheal disease, and malaria; as well as other global health priorities, such as polio and meningitis. We work in partnership with national health ministries, pharmaceutical manufacturers, donors, international financing and regulatory organizations, and many others. PATH has led numerous global partnerships, including the award-winning Meningitis Vaccine Project and the Malaria Vaccine Initiative, which helped develop the first malaria vaccine candidate recommended for pilot implementation.

PATH is seeking a Senior Statistician who is an experienced clinical trial biostatistician to support the design, planning, execution, and analysis of Phase 1, 2, and 3 vaccine clinical trials, with an initial focus on oral polio vaccine studies. Within CVIA, the polio program supports the global polio eradication effort through a broad portfolio of clinical, epidemiological, and diagnostic work, including clinical development of novel oral polio vaccines (nOPVs), with projects spanning early-phase safety and immunogenicity studies through large Phase 3 international clinical trials. The Senior Statistician’s initial focus will be on the clinical development of nOPVs, including two Phase 3 trials currently in design stage, with opportunities to contribute to other CVIA vaccine development programs as needed.

Reporting to the Director of Statistics and Data Management, under the leadership of the Global Head of Clinical, statisticians on the clinical team support CVIA programs by overseeing CROs; contributing to protocol design; developing statistical analysis plans; analyzing trial data; drafting and reviewing clinical study reports and manuscripts; and providing statistical consultation on the design and analysis of clinical trials and epidemiological studies.

This role requires both hands-on statistical leadership and effective oversight of external partners, with responsibilities spanning protocol design, analysis planning, clinical study reporting, regulatory support, and scientific communication.


Please apply by Wednesday, October 7, 2026 end of day for priority consideration.

Responsibilities:


  • Serve as a study statistician for Phase 1, 2, and 3 clinical trials of oral polio vaccines (OPVs, nOPVs), conducting, supporting, and overseeing all statistical activities across all phases of these studies.
  • Lead or contribute to the statistical design of OPV/nOPV trials, including sample size and power calculations, randomization schedules, interim/futility analyses, and Data and Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) support.
  • Develop or review statistical analysis plans and analyze and interpret data from OPV trials (e.g., immunogenicity, shedding, and safety endpoints), providing input to study reports and manuscripts with emphasis on the statistical methods section.
  • Provide statistical support to CVIA’s broader clinical development programs to ensure that scientifically valid conclusions are drawn concerning claims with respect to efficacy and safety of the products under development.
  • Contribute to and/or review study protocols, Investigator’s Brochures (IBs), Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), and other study-related documents in order to ensure collection of required data and correctness of statistical representation of data and results.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for statistical issues between the study team and statistical CRO partner, providing technical oversight of statistical CRO activities, including review of analysis specifications, statistical outputs, data review deliverables, and timelines.
  • Support scientific merit reviews (SMR) of CVIA protocols to ensure high standards of rigor and scientific validity.
  • Give clear, well-organized in-house presentations of relevant statistical material when requested.
  • Attend and represent PATH CVIA at key domestic and international scientific meetings.
  • Keep abreast of new developments in the field by reading, attending seminars, and reviewing publications.
  • Participate in the preparation and review of regulatory and prequalification submissions for clinical trials receiving PATH support (e.g., develop templates for Integrated Summary of Safety (ISS) and Integrated Summary of Efficacy (ISE) statistical tables, provide specs, conducts analysis or supervises production of ISS and ISE tables).

Required skills and experience:

  • Master or Doctoral degree in biostatistics, statistics, or a related scientific discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Five or more years of experience supporting clinical research, preferably including experience presenting and discussing statistical results and study designs with external stakeholders and funders, such as the Gates Foundation.
  • Advanced knowledge of biostatistics and clinical trial methodology.
  • Experience supporting vaccine clinical trials strongly preferred; experience with polio or enteric vaccine studies a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of statistical software programming with languages such as SAS and R.
  • Ability to support US as well as international trials.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously and also have the flexibility of working both collaboratively and independently in a multidisciplinary project environment.
  • Ability to multi-task and effectively prioritize work and projects.
  • Ability to work as a member of multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability to clearly communicate basic statistical concepts to other scientists and nonscientists.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 10–15%.
  • Ability to communicate fully in English
  • Must have legal authorization to work in PATH country location, such as US, UK, Switzerland, or Belgium. Fully remote candidates in PATH country locations will be considered.

PATH is a diverse nonprofit organization that creates a culture of collaboration and partnership. Learn more about the impact you can make globally here.


We offer our employees a competitive salary and generous benefits. For candidates based in the U.S., the annual salary range for this position is $144,000-$180,000. The final salary is based on a variety of objective factors. PATH provides a comprehensive benefit package that includes 15 vacation, 11 holiday, 2 personal, and 12 sick days per year; medical and dental plans; life insurance; and disability and retirement benefits. For more details click here.

Remote & Hybrid Work

PATH operates within a hybrid workplace model unless otherwise noted. Hybrid employees must reside within commuting distance of one of our PATH offices. PATH’s US offices are located in Seattle, WA, and Washington, DC. This position is approved to be a remote employee from a US state where PATH is registered.


Please apply by Wednesday, October 7, 2026 end of day for priority consideration.

raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for an Account Executive, Merchant Platforms to help bring new merchants and businesses onto Bask Health's platform.

You'll work with e-commerce businesses, digital brands, entrepreneurs, and established companies that want to launch or expand their own telehealth offerings.

Bask provides the technology and operational infrastructure businesses need to manage storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and other aspects of their telehealth businesses.

You'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through discovery, product demonstrations, commercial negotiations, and closing.

This role requires someone who understands how merchants operate, can identify business opportunities, and knows how to explain the value of a technology platform to founders and commercial decision-makers.

You'll collaborate with Sales Development, Solutions Engineering, Revenue Operations, Product, and Customer Success to develop new business opportunities and help prospective merchants evaluate Bask's platform.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with entrepreneurs, understands e-commerce business models, and takes ownership of building and closing a strong sales pipeline.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle for new merchant platform opportunities.

  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of new business opportunities.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering on technical requirements and integration discussions.
  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering when prospective customers have complex requirements.
  • Develop commercial proposals using approved pricing and deal structures.
  • Work with Revenue Operations and Finance on pricing questions and nonstandard requests.
  • Lead commercial negotiations within established approval guidelines.
  • Manage objections and guide prospective merchants through purchasing decisions.
  • Develop clear next steps and mutual action plans for qualified opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate deal records, customer requirements, and next steps in the CRM.
  • Track pipeline progression, forecasted revenue, and expected closing dates.
  • Participate in pipeline reviews and sales forecasting meetings.
  • Work toward assigned new-business and revenue targets.
  • Collaborate with Sales Development on merchant prospecting and qualification.
  • Provide feedback on lead quality and merchant acquisition strategies.
  • Partner with Marketing to understand relevant lead sources and campaigns.
  • Identify recurring merchant requirements and customer objections.
  • Share customer feedback with Product and Sales leadership.
  • Help improve sales messaging for e-commerce and merchant audiences.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Bask's products, workflows, and commercial offerings.
  • Stay informed about developments in e-commerce, merchant technology, and telehealth.
  • Coordinate with Customer Success on post-sale handoffs.
  • Document important customer expectations and commercial commitments.
  • Support improvements to the merchant acquisition sales process.
  • Take ownership of pipeline development, deal progression, and sales results.

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, Account Executive roles, merchant technology sales, or a related full-cycle sales position.
  • Experience managing new-business opportunities from discovery through closing.

  • Experience selling software, technology platforms, or complex business solutions.

  • Strong relationship-building skills with founders, entrepreneurs, and business leaders.

  • Experience collaborating with technical teams during sales opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of CRM management, pipeline forecasting, and sales reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities at different stages of the sales cycle.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working toward assigned sales targets.

  • Ability to learn new software platforms and communicate their value.

Nice to Have

Medical Director, Clinical Quality, Safety & Governance

Position Description

The Medical Director, Clinical Quality, Safety & Governance, under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, is responsible for leading clinical quality, patient safety, and governance initiatives across MDLIVE's clinical services and care experiences.

This role provides strategic oversight of patient safety programs, clinical quality improvement initiatives, provider performance management and education, clinical governance, and technology-enabled care capabilities. The Medical Director partners with Clinical, Operations, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Security, and Risk Management teams to ensure the safe, effective, and consistent delivery of care across both clinician-delivered and technology-enabled care experiences.

The Medical Director integrates clinical data, analytics, operational processes, and quality improvement methodologies to drive continuous improvement in patient outcomes, patient safety, provider performance, and care delivery. The position includes maintaining an active clinical practice to inform quality, safety, and governance activities.

Essential Job Functions

Clinical Quality & Patient Safety

  • Leads clinical quality and patient safety initiatives across MDLIVE service lines.
  • Oversees peer review, provider quality review, patient safety events, and quality improvement programs.
  • Develops, implements, and optimizes systems for monitoring clinical quality, patient safety, and provider performance.
  • Plans, executes, and reports on data-driven quality improvement initiatives.
  • Establishes and maintains enterprise clinical quality and safety measurement frameworks, including metric definitions, performance thresholds, monitoring approaches, escalation criteria, and reporting.
  • Oversees the timely identification, triage, investigation, root-cause analysis, documentation, escalation, corrective action, and follow-up of patient-safety events, quality concerns, emerging trends, and clinical risks.
  • Monitors trends in patient-safety events, complaints, clinical documentation, prescribing practices, peer review findings, and provider performance to identify emerging or systemic risks.

Provider Performance & Clinical Excellence

  • Provides consultation, guidance, and subject matter expertise to providers and operational staff regarding quality and patient safety standards.
  • Establishes clear provider performance expectations, accountability standards, escalation pathways, and resolution processes related to clinical quality and patient safety.
  • Supports provider coaching, remediation, and performance improvement activities.
  • Serves as a clinical leader in fostering a culture of accountability, safety, and clinical quality improvement (CQI).
  • Supports provider education and professional development initiatives related to quality, patient safety, governance, and emerging clinical technologies.
  • Evaluates the effectiveness of provider education and professional-development initiatives and updates content based on performance data, safety events, emerging risks, and organizational priorities.
  • Develops and oversees provider coaching, remediation, and performance-improvement plans and, when appropriate, recommends corrective or disciplinary action in partnership with the appropriate clinical, operational, network, legal, and compliance stakeholders.
  • Develops and delivers education for employees, contractors, and clinical providers on patient safety, risk mitigation, clinical quality, governance requirements, and lessons learned from safety events and quality reviews.

Committee & Governance Leadership

  • Maintains and chairs the MDLIVE Patient Safety Committee.
  • Participates in and leads CQI and other clinical governance committees as assigned.
  • Develops committee goals, work plans, reporting structures, and improvement initiatives.
  • Leads governance review of clinical programs, technology-enabled care capabilities, and patient safety concerns.
  • Recommends program enhancements, resource allocation, corrective actions, and quality improvement priorities based on organizational performance and risk.

Clinical Governance & Risk Management

  • Supports development and implementation of clinical policies, practice guidelines, standards, and best practices.
  • Serves as a subject matter expert in patient safety, clinical quality, clinical workflows, and governance processes.
  • Partners with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Security, and Risk Management teams to address clinical risks and regulatory requirements.
  • Leads multidisciplinary review of quality, safety, and governance concerns across clinical services.
  • Supports enterprise clinical risk-management activities and mitigation strategies.

Technology-Enabled Care Quality

  • Collaborates with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Clinical leaders to evaluate quality and safety implications of care navigation, triage, clinical decision support, and other technology-enabled care capabilities.
  • Leads development of governance and monitoring approaches for technology-enabled clinical workflows and patient-facing recommendations.
  • Evaluates quality and safety across both clinician-delivered and technology-enabled care experiences.
  • Assists in identifying and mitigating risks associated with new clinical technologies, workflows, and care models.
  • Leads evaluation of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, for clinical quality, patient safety, operational effectiveness, and patient experience.
  • Establishes risk-based clinical review, validation, monitoring, and escalation requirements for new or materially changed technology-enabled clinical capabilities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborates with clinical, operational, product, analytics, and technology teams to improve care delivery and patient outcomes.
  • Serves as a trusted advisor on quality, safety, governance, and clinical performance matters.
  • Facilitates effective communication between clinical stakeholders and business, operational, and technical teams.
  • Supports enterprise initiatives that improve patient outcomes, provider experience, and operational effectiveness.

External Leadership & Clinical Practice

  • Maintains active clinical practice to preserve clinical expertise and inform quality, safety, and governance activities.
  • Utilizes ongoing clinical experience to guide policy development, operational decisions, technology evaluation, and quality improvement efforts.
  • Represent MDLIVE as a clinical leader and subject matter expert in quality, safety and technovigilence in emerging models of tech-enabled care.
  • Participate in client engagements, industry forums, professional organizations, and thought-leadership opportunities.

Other Duties

  • Performs additional responsibilities consistent with the role's education, training, expertise, and organizational needs.

Required Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • Expertise in clinical quality, patient safety, risk management, and quality improvement methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, planning, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to evaluate quality and safety across both clinician-delivered and technology-enabled care experiences.
  • Experience working effectively across clinical, operational, and technology teams.
  • Ability to interpret clinical, operational, and quality performance data.
  • Effective communication skills with providers, multidisciplinary teams, and executive leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement, clinical excellence, patient-centered care, and responsible innovation.

Education & Experience

  • MD or DO degree with active, unrestricted medical licensure.
  • Board certification in a relevant specialty.
  • 10+ years practice experience, with aspects of both clinical care and administrative duties
  • Experience leading patient safety, clinical quality, clinical governance, risk management, provider performance, or quality improvement initiatives.
  • Knowledge of patient safety science, clinical risk management, peer review, provider performance management, and quality improvement methodologies.
  • Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and provider peers.
  • Demonstrated experience leading committees, governance processes, quality review programs, or enterprise improvement initiatives.
  • Experience in telehealth/virtual care preferred.
  • Experience evaluating quality and safety across both clinician-delivered and technology-enabled care models preferred.
  • Familiarity with care navigation, triage, clinical decision support, AI-enabled healthcare technologies, or emerging technology-enabled care models preferred.
  • Training or experience in clinical informatics, quality improvement, patient safety, healthcare management, or healthcare analytics preferred.

You’ll perform electrical engineering work including design, design review, construction support service for wastewater treatment plants and pumps stations. Responsibilities include:

  • Responsible for bringing project from the design stage through to completion with multiple project team members.

  • Field investigative and start-up experience
  • The ability to balance multiple work assignments on multiple projects at the same time is required.
  • The ability to work alone but also effectively as part of a team is required.
  • Requires process-oriented thinking with strong organizational and technical skills.
  • Requires excellent communication, and the ability to take and understand directives from Project Engineers and Project Managers.

This role works directly with client stakeholders, suppliers, and internal Monument leadership to develop and execute sourcing strategies, review and negotiate Statements of Work (SOWs), and deliver measurable cost, risk, and value outcomes.

This position is ideal for a procurement professional who has experience supporting external clients, thrives in a consulting environment, and is comfortable balancing relationship management with hands‑on execution.

This position will be a member of the Procurement-as-a-Service (PaaS) team, reporting to the PaaS Practice Director.

  • Track, document, and communicate sourcing outcomes and savings results to both clients and Monument leadership

  • Ability to adapt quickly to new client environments, industries, and expectations
  • Support onboarding of new client engagements or procurement transitions
  • Assist with mentoring junior team members as applicable
  • Represent Monument professionally in all client and supplier interactions
  • Perform other duties as assigned to meet client or business needs

Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of experience in strategic sourcing or procurement
  • 3-5 years of managing professional services and/or IT services SOW engagements
  • Prior experience in consulting, managed services, or client‑facing procurement role is preferred
  • Demonstrated experience leading sourcing projects and RFx events independently
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or relevant certifications (CPSM, CPM, CSCP) a plus
  • Experience applying Strategic Sourcing methodology
  • Experience managing RFx events in various P2P, sourcing or VMS applications
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools to enhance productivity and generate tangible value-add results

USD $115,000.00 - USD $125,000.00 /Yr.

About Cozey

At Cozey, we’re all about empowering possibilities in your home and making furniture shopping as easy and enjoyable as possible. Our thoughtfully designed, stylish furnishings adapt to evolving lifestyles, combining innovation with a commitment to great value and customer service. As a fast-growing, online-first brand, our success is driven by a team that shares our passion for redefining the furniture experience.

The mission of the Manager, Retail Experience & Education at Cozey

Reporting to the Vice-President, Retail Strategy & Operations, you’ll shape how our retail teams learn, lead and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

As Cozey continues to expand its retail footprint, you’ll build the coaching and education programs that develop confident leaders, elevate selling behaviours and bring our brand experience to life in every store. With a strong foundation in product training already in place, your focus will be on developing our leaders as coaches, creating a culture of continuous learning and ensuring training translates into meaningful results.

This is a remote role open across Canada. You’ll need to be based near one of our Cozey retail store locations, either in Edmonton, Calgary, Toronto, Montreal or Vancouver, with approximately 25–30% travel.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build a scalable coaching program that empowers Store Managers, Assistant Store Managers and Key Holders to become stronger coaches, give constructive feedback and navigate challenging conversations with confidence.
  • Bring Cozey’s selling philosophy to life by translating customer experience expectations into everyday behaviours that strengthen customer connections and elevate the in-store experience.
  • Design engaging leadership and sales development programs, tools and resources that make learning practical, memorable and easy to apply on the sales floor.
  • Partner with Product to continuously evolve product training and ensure every team member has the knowledge and confidence to speak to our collections.
  • Measure the impact of learning by tracking training completion, knowledge retention and on-floor performance, using insights to continuously improve programs.
  • Get out into our retail locations to coach leaders and teams firsthand, reinforce best practices and help drive stronger store performance.
  • Partner with Retail Operations, Marketing, Product and Customer Experience to create a consistent, connected experience across our digital and physical retail channels.
  • Build scalable education and coaching frameworks to support Cozey’s retail expansion, with the opportunity to eventually grow and lead an in-market training team.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • 5+ years of experience in retail, with at least 2 years in a role focused on customer experience, training or retail operations.
  • Experience developing leaders and coaching managers on how to lead, motivate and develop their teams.
  • A strong understanding of what makes a great selling experience, with the ability to translate customer experience standards into everyday behaviours.
  • Confidence facilitating engaging learning experiences, whether leading a group of retail leaders or coaching someone one-on-one on a busy sales floor.
  • The ability to navigate challenging conversations, deliver constructive feedback and help others build confidence in their leadership.
  • A balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution: you can build a program, bring people along and see it through on the sales floor.
  • A data-informed approach to learning, with the ability to measure impact and turn insights into action.
  • Curiosity about AI and emerging tools, and an interest in using them to make learning content and resources more effective and efficient.
  • The flexibility to travel approximately 25–30% of the time. Bilingualism in English and French is an asset.

Most importantly, you’re someone who genuinely enjoys developing people. You know that great customer experiences start with great leaders, and you’re energized by the opportunity to help build both.

We care about you

  • You will receive a competitive salary along with a comprehensive benefit package.
  • Endless opportunities for personal and professional growth in a fast-growing start-up.
  • A generous PTO policy that allows you the time you need to recharge.
  • A role where your strategies and decisions directly influence the company’s operations and growth.
  • A workspace where everyone is welcomed, heard, and valued.

Please note that we may use AI-powered tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as application screening and interview coordination. These tools help us focus our time where it matters most: getting to know candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people, and we’re committed to a fair and inclusive process.

raw.description:
Note: We are exclusively hiring for this role in the Philippines or India through our Employer of Record, Rippling. We are not vetting U.S. applicants at this time. You will receive full local statutory benefits compliant with your country of residence.

Keep the Numbers Behind a Growing Ecosystem Accurate, On Time and Running Smoothly

Do you love clean books, a closed reconciliation, and a process that runs the same way every time?

At New Law Business Model (NLBM), we help people make informed legal and financial decisions through education, advisory services, and technology. Our businesses include Eyes Wide Open Collective, the Personal Family Lawyer network, LIFTed Advisors, and Whole Truth Media.

We’re growing, and we’re building our Finance and Accounting team to match.

We’re looking for an Accounting & Finance Specialist who brings strong accounting fundamentals, careful attention to detail, and real ownership of recurring deadlines.

This isn’t a data-entry role. You’ll own key parts of our accounts payable, payroll accounting, commissions and intercompany processes across several entities. You’ll also help us find better, smarter ways to get the work done with AI and automation.

If you love accuracy and making processes better, you’ll feel right at home.

The Opportunity

You’ll support the finance operations of a multi-entity ecosystem:

  • New Law Business Model (NLBM): Education, coaching and services that help attorneys build thriving estate planning practices.

  • EWOC and related entities (EWOL, PFL, PFLIA): Connected businesses with shared services, intercompany activity and their own books.

Reporting to our Controller, you’ll keep payments timely, entries accurate and month-end clean. That frees the rest of the finance team to focus on reporting, forecasting and analysis.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

Own Accounts Payable

  • Manage AP preparation: maintain the accounting inbox, enter invoices in Bill.com and validate contractor charges against their agreements.

  • Coordinate approvals through the payment matrix so vendors and contractors are paid on time.

  • Maintain U.S. vendor records and U.S. W-9s, resolve payment inquiries and coordinate approved out-of-cycle payments.

  • Provide backup AP and payroll processing.

Run Payroll Accounting & Commissions

  • Prepare timesheets for manager approval and review payroll reports and entity allocations.

  • Record payroll journal entries in QuickBooks Online for each pay cycle.

  • Calculate and validate monthly commissions against approved compensation plans and coordinate timely payouts.

Keep Multi-Entity Books Clean

  • Record credit card transactions under the correct entity.

  • Reconcile intercompany loans, including costs paid on behalf of other companies, at month-end.

  • Support month-end reviews, year-end close, U.S. 1099 Tax Form preparation and external tax or audit requests across our U.S.-based entities: NLBM, EWOC, EWOL, PFL and PFLIA.

  • Monitor payment disputes in Stripe and HubSpot and coordinate follow-up with the responsible team.

Make Finance Operations Easier & More Scalable

  • Document procedures and keep finance records and access permissions organized.

  • Help test AI and automation improvements that reduce manual work in invoice processing, reconciliations and reporting.

  • Support analyses, special projects and coverage during team absences.

What You Could Work On First

  • Learn our AP cycle: Take ownership of invoice intake, the payment matrix and approvals.

  • Own payroll journal entries: Record and allocate payroll accurately across entities each pay cycle.

  • Strengthen month-end: Bring intercompany reconciliations and commission payouts onto a consistent, documented process.

  • Document and improve: Turn recurring tasks into clear SOPs and find opportunities for automation.

Who We’re Looking For

You’re a dependable accounting professional who takes pride in accurate work, communicates clearly and manages recurring deadlines without being chased.

You can investigate a discrepancy until it’s resolved, and you’re curious about tools that make the work faster and better.

You Bring

  • Accounting or bookkeeping experience with strong reconciliation skills and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.

  • Strong QuickBooks Online skills, including transaction coding, journal entries and account reconciliations.

  • Strong Google Sheets skills, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables and data validation.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, reliable follow-through and the ability to manage recurring deadlines independently on a remote team.

  • Familiarity with AI tools for documentation, data review and recurring tasks, with careful verification of outputs.

Even Better If You Have

  • Hands-on experience with Bill.com and Rippling.

  • Experience with multi-entity U.S. GAAP accounting, intercompany reconciliations, payroll accounting and commissions.

  • Experience implementing, testing and documenting AI agents or workflow automations that improve invoice processing, reconciliations or reporting.

You don’t need to be a CPA, but you should love getting the numbers right and making processes better.

You’ll Thrive Here If...

  • You take ownership of your work and deliver on recurring deadlines.

  • You enjoy the satisfaction of a clean reconciliation and a well-documented process.

  • You communicate blockers early and ask good questions.

  • You’re curious about AI, automation and better ways of working.

  • You thrive on a small, collaborative team where your work is visible and valued.

Why NLBM?

  • Meaningful work. Support businesses that help families and attorneys make better legal and financial decisions.

  • Real impact. Your work directly keeps payments, payroll and reporting accurate across the ecosystem.

  • Learn multi-entity accounting. Gain hands-on experience across several connected businesses.

  • Innovation with purpose. Help apply AI and automation to real finance workflows.

  • People-first culture. Join a collaborative finance team committed to growth.

  • Room to grow. Expand your skills and take on more ownership as the company scales.

Position Details & Benefits

  • Employment: Full-time, remote (EOR via Rippling) in the Philippines or India

  • Department: Finance and Accounting

  • Reports to: Controller

  • Compensation: 3,000-4,000 USD per month

  • Hours: 8 a.m.–5 p.m. MT

Benefits include:

  • Paid time off

  • Monthly internet/technology allowance

  • Opportunities for career growth and professional development

  • 100% remote work at a growing company

  • Full local statutory benefits mandated by your country of residence

Interested? Let’s Talk.

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just want to process transactions, but wants to help build a finance function that runs smoothly as we grow.

If you’re excited about accurate books, on-time payments, and better processes, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a 100% remote position open exclusively to candidates residing in the Philippines or India, hired legally through our Employer of Record (EOR), Rippling.

Team members are expected to maintain a dedicated workspace with reliable high-speed internet and hardware capable of running modern SaaS and automation workflows (minimum 16GB RAM). New Law Business Model (NLBM) provides all required software licenses, security access, and a monthly home office/technology allowance (processed in accordance with local EOR payroll regulations) to assist with remote workspace and internet expenses.

NLBM respects your time and work. Any portfolio materials, technical breakdowns, or operational insights submitted during this application process are requested solely for the purpose of assessing your qualifications for this position. NLBM will not use, publish, or commercially exploit any material submitted during your application process without your express written consent. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that any skills assessments do not create an employment relationship or a contract for services with NLBM or Rippling.

NLBM provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable local laws in the Philippines and India (including the Philippine Magna Carta for Persons with Disability and India's Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act). If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interviewing process, please contact us at .

New Law Business Model is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply without regard to age, sex, gender identity, marital status, religion, disability, or health status.

Neither NLBM nor our recruitment partners charge any application, placement, or processing fees at any stage of hiring. By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, processing, and cross-border transfer of your personal data by NLBM (United States) and Rippling for recruitment and pre-employment verification purposes in accordance with the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Finalists will be asked to provide separate written consent for pre-employment background and financial checks.

raw.excerpt: Get to know us better CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms.
raw.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

We develop software for modern networking platforms, embedded systems, and operating systems for leading global equipment manufacturers and high-tech innovators.

In this project, you will join a team developing an advanced ARM-based SoC embedded solution for the aerospace sector, dedicated to high-speed data transmission between nodes (satellites and ground stations). You will work right at the hardware-software boundary—focusing on building dedicated diagnostic, profiling, and performance testing tools while collaborating closely with the core SoC firmware, software, and validation teams.

What else you should know:

  • You will work directly with physical hardware, lab setups, and low-level SoC software stacks

  • The project is managed by the client, with active support and coordination from a CodiLime Engineering Manager

  • You will collaborate with an international client team based across the UK, EU, and Israel, with the possibility of working with teams in Canada as well

Your role

As a part of the team, your responsibility will be to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain low-level diagnostic, validation, and performance testing tools for an ARM-based SoC platform

  • Build traffic generation and throughput/latency measurement utilities to verify high-speed data transmission

  • Profile system and memory performance (cache behavior, DMA transfers, zero-copy paths) and troubleshoot low-level bottlenecks or crashes

  • Work directly on physical lab hardware alongside core SoC firmware/software and validation teams

  • Leverage modern AI coding tools in your daily workflow and take part in technical discussions with the client team

Do we have a match?

The candidate must meet most of the following criteria:

  • Strong proficiency in C and basic C++ (C with classes) in a Linux environment

  • Solid understanding of system architecture and memory management (virtual memory, paging, RAM vs. cache, DMA, zero-copy, CPU core isolation)

  • Practical experience with Linux profiling and debugging tools (Linux Perf, Valgrind, GDB, kernel crash analysis like kDump/kExec)

  • Solid networking fundamentals (Ethernet, IP, VLANs, switching/FDB, routing) and performance concepts (throughput, packet/bit rate, traffic generators)

  • Openness to using AI-assisted coding tools in daily workflows, plus English at least B2 level (C1/C2 preferred)

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with low-level memory concepts (memory barriers, cache invalidation, cache misses, huge pages)

  • Experience working with hardware interfaces (I2C, AXI, SPI) and building tools for testing firmware and hardware

  • Basic understanding of embedded Linux build and boot tools (Buildroot, Yocto, U-Boot)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

JOB TITLE: Logistics Analyst

REPORTS TO: Global Director of Supply Chain & Logistics

STATUS: Fulltime, Exempt

LOCATION: Remote – East Coast

SALARY: $85,000 - $100,000/year based on interview outcome & overall experience

BENEFITS:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance, optional FSA/HSA, 401k with 6% employer match, life and AD&D insurance, Employee Assistance Program, short & long-term disability, tuition reimbursement, 21.67 days of paid time off + 10 holidays

About Tidal Vision:

We believe that sustainability should not require customers to compromise on price, convenience, or performance. Our mission is to create positive and systemic environmental impact by making our biopolymer solutions cost competitive, more convenient, and better performing than the synthetic chemicals we displace. We value innovation and take pride in challenging the status-quo; we choose to view obstacles as opportunities. We value new ideas and encourage the team to apply creativity and invent new solutions to meet challenging demands. We foster open, direct communication, and a collaborative working environment through our unique approach to work culture. We value our employees and demonstrate that through our compensation and benefits programs and opportunities for growth and development.

About Our Unique Work Culture:

Tidal Vision strives to build and invest in the highest performing and most innovative team. We put our people and customers above process, avoid company-wide rules as much as possible, and have the courage to take unusual approaches to advance our mission. With this approach, we believe we can create a more flexible, fun, stimulating, creative, collaborative, and innovative organization.

Our commitment to developing, practicing and promoting direct and open communication, responsibility and freedom, and leading with and seeking context is a responsibility for every role at Tidal Vision.

Job Summary:

The Logistics Analyst manages the movement of goods into, out of, and across the U.S. About half the role is international: booking ocean and air exports with freight forwarders, preparing export documents, and clearing imports through customs with the customs broker. The other half is domestic: scheduling, tracking, and managing carrier performance for truckload (TL), less-than-truckload (LTL), and bulk liquid tank truck shipments.

Essential Job Functions

International exports (ocean and air)

  • Obtain and compare rates from freight forwarders for ocean and air export shipments.
  • Book shipments with the selected forwarder and confirm cutoffs, sailing or flight schedules, and delivery commitments.
  • Prepare and process all export documents, including the Shipper's Letter of Instruction (SLI), commercial invoice, and packing list, and send them to the freight forwarder.
  • Confirm export classification and filing details (Schedule B/HTS codes, ECCN, EEI filing in AES) are accurate.
  • Coordinate dangerous goods documentation and labeling for hazardous shipments with the forwarder.

International imports

  • Manage all imports into the U.S. from booking through delivery.
  • Work with the customs broker to clear goods through U.S. Customs, providing accurate commercial invoices, packing lists, and classification information.
  • Track inbound shipments and resolve customs holds, exams, and documentation issues.

Domestic transportation

  • Schedule truckload (TL), less-than-truckload (LTL), and bulk liquid tank truck shipments.
  • Track shipments from pickup through delivery and communicate delays to customers, production, and planning.
  • Monitor carrier performance on on-time pickup and delivery, damage, and cost.
  • Obtain carrier quotes and select carriers based on cost, service, and capability.
  • Schedule shipments on the company's private fleet of tankers and tractors when it is the better option than a third-party carrier.

Reporting and compliance

  • Maintain accurate shipment records and documentation for audits and compliance.
  • Process and approve freight invoices for international and domestic shipments, reviewing them against quotes and resolving discrepancies.
  • Report on freight costs, carrier performance, and shipment status to management.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4–5+ years in logistics, with hands-on experience in both international and domestic shipping.
  • Experience booking ocean and air exports through freight forwarders and preparing export documentation, including the SLI.
  • Experience working with customs brokers to clear U.S. imports.
  • Working knowledge of Incoterms, Schedule B/HTS classification, and EEI filing requirements.
  • Experience scheduling and managing TL and LTL carriers.
  • Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, basic reporting) and proficiency with Word and Outlook.
  • Clear, firm written and verbal communication with forwarders, brokers, carriers, and internal teams.
  • High attention to detail, documentation discipline, and follow-through on open items.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience shipping bulk liquids by tank truck.
  • Experience shipping chemicals or other hazardous materials, with dangerous goods training or certification (49 CFR, IATA, IMDG).
  • Familiarity with export controls (EAR/ECCN) and Importer Security Filing (ISF).
  • Experience using NetSuite or a transportation management system (TMS).
  • Licensed Customs Broker (LCB) or Certified Export Specialist (CES) credential.
  • Experience with private fleet management or scheduling a private fleet alongside third-party carriers, including familiarity with DOT/FMCSA requirements.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • Minimal travel required (as needed for key meetings or project support). Estimated 5%-10%.
  • Time split – 50% International, 50% domestic
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer and standard office tools.
  • The employee may occasionally visit industrial or customer sites and should be comfortable in those environments.

Licensing & Special Requirements:

  • The incumbent is subject to background check.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

    • Evidence repositories
    • Assessment tracking tools
    • Compliance documentation repositories
  • Strong written communication skills with experience developing:

    • Technical documentation
    • Assessment records
    • Interview notes
    • Compliance reports
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced project environment.
  • Experience working collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CompTIA Security+ certification.
  • CompTIA CySA+ certification.
  • Pursuing or planning to obtain Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP) certification.
  • Experience supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) programs.
  • Exposure to Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Experience supporting federal cybersecurity compliance initiatives and assessment activities.

The EMEA Benefits Analyst is responsible for the effective administration, coordination, and continuous improvement of employee benefits programs across the EMEA region. This role plays a critical part in ensuring benefits programs are delivered accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable local regulations and company policies.


Working closely with the EMEA Benefits Lead (IC5) and Global Benefits leadership, the Analyst will independently manage assigned regional benefits activities, coordinate annual renewals, support regulatory compliance, oversee day-to-day vendor relationships, and drive operational improvements.


The role requires strong analytical capabilities, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex, multinational benefits environments while collaborating with regional HR, Payroll, Finance, Legal, HRIS, brokers, and external providers.


Benefits Operations & Regional Administration

  • Independently manage the day-to-day administration of assigned EMEA employee benefits programs, including medical, life insurance, disability, retirement, pension, leave, and other statutory and company-sponsored benefits.
  • Serve as a regional benefits subject matter resource, providing guidance on program eligibility, plan provisions, administrative processes, and country-specific requirements.
  • Coordinate benefits-related onboarding, offboarding, employee transfers, and qualifying life events, ensuring accurate enrollment and timely coverage changes.
  • Partner with HR Shared Services, Payroll, HR Business Partners, and regional People Operations teams to resolve complex employee benefits issues.
  • Identify operational gaps, implement process improvements, and support consistent benefits administration across countries.
  • Maintain accurate standard operating procedures, country-specific benefits documentation, process workflows, and administrative controls.
  • Provide regular updates to the EMEA Benefits Lead on operational activities, emerging issues, and areas requiring additional attention.

Benefits Renewals & Program Management

  • Manage the operational execution of annual benefits renewals across assigned EMEA countries, including data collection, census validation, proposal reviews, implementation, and employee communications.
  • Collaborate with the EMEA Benefits Lead and brokers to evaluate renewal proposals, market competitiveness, plan utilization, and cost trends.
  • Prepare benefits comparisons, financial analyses, and recommendations to support regional renewal and program design decisions.
  • Coordinate implementation of approved plan changes, ensuring accurate system updates, vendor coordination, and employee communications.
  • Maintain renewal trackers, timelines, and deliverables to ensure completion of assigned activities.
  • Support regional benefits harmonization initiatives and opportunities to improve program efficiency, competitiveness, and employee experience.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting employee benefits, statutory pensions, leave programs, and other benefit-related obligations across assigned EMEA countries.
  • Partner with the EMEA Benefits Lead, Legal, Payroll, and external advisors to assess regulatory changes and coordinate necessary program updates.
  • Maintain and review EMEA leave and time-off policies, including Workday processes, to support accuracy and compliance with local requirements.
  • Coordinate benefits-related audits, statutory reporting, documentation reviews, and internal compliance assessments.
  • Identify potential compliance gaps, recommend corrective actions, and coordinate implementation of approved remediation activities.
  • Maintain accurate benefits records, documentation, and audit trails to support governance, internal controls, and applicable data privacy requirements.
  • Escalate material compliance risks and significant regulatory changes to the EMEA Benefits Lead.

Vendor & Broker Management

  • Manage day-to-day operational relationships with assigned regional brokers, insurers, pension administrators, and benefits providers.
  • Monitor vendor performance, service-level commitments, deliverables, and issue resolution.
  • Coordinate vendor escalations, track outstanding issues, and drive timely resolution of operational matters.
  • Support vendor governance reviews by preparing performance summaries, identifying recurring issues, and recommending service improvements.
  • Review benefits invoices, eligibility records, and vendor data to identify discrepancies and coordinate corrections with Finance, Payroll, and external providers.
  • Support vendor evaluations, contract reviews, and regional broker initiatives under the direction of the EMEA Benefits Lead and Global Benefits leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to improve vendor accountability, financial accuracy, and operational efficiency.

Benefits Systems, Data Analytics & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate benefits-related data and administrative processes within Workday and other applicable benefits systems.
  • Partner with HRIS and People Operations to coordinate system testing, configuration updates, data validation, and implementation of approved benefits changes.
  • Perform benefits data reconciliations across Workday, Payroll, Finance, and external providers.
  • Prepare and analyze regional benefits reports covering enrollment, participation, utilization, costs, and operational performance.
  • Support benefits budgeting, annual operating plan development, cost forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Identify data discrepancies, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to strengthen reporting and financial controls.
  • Recommend and implement approved automation, standardization, and system improvements to reduce manual administration and improve accuracy.

Employee Experience & Communications

  • Serve as an escalation resource for complex employee benefits inquiries, ensuring accurate and timely resolution.
  • Partner with HR Shared Services and regional HR teams to provide policy guidance, administrative support, and employee education.
  • Develop and maintain regional benefits communications, intranet content, enrollment materials, and onboarding resources.
  • Coordinate communications related to annual renewals, regulatory changes, and approved benefits enhancements.
  • Support employee education initiatives to improve awareness, understanding, and utilization of available benefits programs.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance employee self-service capabilities and improve the overall benefits experience.

Mergers, Acquisitions & Regional Initiatives

  • Manage assigned benefits workstreams supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, entity transitions, and organizational changes across EMEA.
  • Gather and validate benefits information, prepare plan comparisons, identify coverage gaps, and support integration recommendations.
  • Coordinate approved benefits transitions with internal stakeholders, brokers, and external vendors to ensure continuity of coverage.
  • Lead assigned regional operational improvement projects, managing deliverables, timelines, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Support benefits harmonization, process standardization, and global benefits transformation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with the EMEA Benefits Lead to execute regional priorities aligned with the Global Benefits strategy.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in employee benefits administration, Total Rewards, or HR Operations, preferably within a multinational organization.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing benefits administration activities across multiple EMEA countries.
  • Working knowledge of EMEA employee benefits programs, statutory requirements, pension arrangements, and leave regulations.
  • Experience coordinating benefits renewals, vendor relationships, and complex employee benefits matters.
  • Strong analytical skills, including benefits cost analysis, data reconciliation, reporting, and financial interpretation.
  • Experience with Workday or a comparable enterprise HRIS platform.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency and ability to manage complex datasets.
  • Strong project management, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and collaborate effectively across functions and geographic regions.
  • Demonstrated commitment to operational accuracy, confidentiality, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting benefits programs across multiple European jurisdictions.
  • Familiarity with regional pension and retirement arrangements, statutory leave programs, and benefits-related regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, benefits harmonization, or international employee transitions.
  • Knowledge of benefits budgeting, invoice reconciliation, vendor governance, and financial controls.
  • Experience with Workday benefits configurations, process automation, and system enhancements.
  • Understanding of GDPR and employee benefits data privacy requirements.
  • Additional European language proficiency is an advantage.

Key Competencies

  • Independent Execution & Accountability: Ability to manage assigned regional responsibilities with minimal supervision while maintaining alignment with leadership priorities.
  • Regional Benefits Knowledge: Strong understanding of multinational benefits administration and EMEA statutory requirements.
  • Operational Excellence: Focus on accuracy, process efficiency, service quality, and effective internal controls.
  • Analytical & Financial Acumen: Ability to interpret benefits data, evaluate costs, and develop meaningful recommendations.
  • Vendor & Stakeholder Collaboration: Ability to manage operational relationships, resolve issues, and influence outcomes.
  • Compliance & Risk Awareness: Proactive identification, escalation, and resolution of regulatory and operational risks.
  • Continuous Improvement: Ability to identify and implement process enhancements, automation, and operational efficiencies.
  • Project Management: Ability to independently manage assigned workstreams, timelines, and deliverables within broader regional and global initiatives.

About Us:

Cloud Software Group is one of the world’s largest cloud solution providers, serving more than 100 million users around the globe. When you join Cloud Software Group, you are making a difference for real people, each of whom count on our suite of cloud-based products to get work done — from anywhere. Members of our team will tell you that we value passion for technology and the courage to take risks. Everyone is empowered to learn, dream, and build the future of work. We are on the brink of another Cambrian leap -- a moment of immense evolution and growth. And we need your expertise and experience to do it. Now is the perfect time to move your skills to the cloud.

Cloud Software Group is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, creed, sex or gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, ethnicity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, genetic carrier status, disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions (including lactation status), marital status, military service, protected veteran status, political activity or affiliation, taking or requesting statutorily protected leave and other protected classifications.

If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any part of the application process, please contact us via the Bridge portal for assistance.

Job Description:

A DXC Technology ajuda empresas globais em seus sistemas e operações de missão crítica modernizando TI, otimizando arquiteturas de dados e garantindo segurança e escalabilidade em nuvem pública, privada e híbrida. As maiores empresas e organizações de setor público confiam na DXC para implantar serviços para impulsionar novos níveis de desempenho, competitividade e experiência do cliente em suas propriedades de TI. Saiba mais sobre como entregamos excelência para nossos clientes e colegas em .

Na DXC, usamos o poder da tecnologia para oferecer serviços de TI essenciais que nossos clientes precisam para modernizar suas operações e impulsionar a inovação em todo o seu ambiente de TI. Fornecemos serviços em toda a Enterprise Technology Stack para terceirização de processos de negócios, seguros, análises e engenharia, aplicações, segurança, nuvem, terceirização de TI e ambiente de trabalho moderno.

Nossos serviços de aplicações DXC ajudam nossos clientes a otimizar e transformar operações, reduzir custos e aumentar a agilidade na abertura de novos canais de crescimento. Nossas pessoas, tecnologias e melhores práticas melhoram e automatizam processos de negócios altamente complexos – nos setores de Analytics, desenvolvimento de sistemas, sustentação de sistemas, enquanto promovem a transformação da experiência do cliente.

Funções Essenciais do Cargo:

A DXC Technology está buscando um Associate Manager Project Management (Level 09) para liderar projetos de Transition & Transformation, com foco em migração de infraestrutura, servidores e aplicações para ambientes de nuvem, incluindo Microsoft Azure e Google Cloud Platform (GCP). O profissional será responsável pela gestão ponta a ponta de projetos complexos, coordenação de equipes multidisciplinares e relacionamento com clientes e stakeholders executivos. O enquadramento de carreira corresponde ao Job Family Project Management, Level 09, Associate Manager.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de transição, transformação e modernização tecnológica.
  • Gerenciar migrações de servidores, aplicações e ambientes de infraestrutura para Azure e Google Cloud.
  • Planejar e controlar cronograma, orçamento, riscos, recursos e governança dos projetos.
  • Coordenar equipes técnicas, fornecedores e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas de acompanhamento e reportar status dos projetos.
  • Garantir a entrega dos projetos dentro do prazo, escopo, custo e qualidade acordados.

Qualificações Básicas

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • experiência em Gerenciamento de Projetos de TI.
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de Cloud Migration, Infrastructure Transformation e Application Migration.
  • Experiência prática na gestão de projetos envolvendo:
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Experiência em metodologias Agile, Waterfall ou híbridas.
  • Inglês fluente.
  • Espanhol fluente

Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Certificação PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP ou equivalente (desejável PMP, porém não obrigatório)
  • Certificações Microsoft Azure ou Google Cloud (desejável)
  • Experiência em ambientes multinacionais e projetos regionais na América Latina (diferencial importante)

Esta posição também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência.

Vários benefícios, salário competitivo e nossos valores fazem da DXC uma das mais importantes e atraentes empresas para se trabalhar no mundo. raw.description:
EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP.

Role Description

We are seeking a talented and experienced Platform Engineer to join our team. Possessing strong proficiency with Kubernetes, the ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of our platform, demonstrating a strong understanding of system architecture, problem-solving skills, and the ability to guide junior engineers.

As a Platform Engineer within our organization, you will join a team of dedicated unicorns who are focused on advancing freedom and independence globally. Our teams work on various different technical baselines depending on specific engagements. We focus our Products on the Platform layer, but to deliver for our Heroes, we also work IaC automation, security, and implementation.

Responsibilities

You will help us automate and build a runtime Production Environment and serve as a link between the Applications, either custom development, COTS, or OSS, and that environment, advocating best practices and facilitating communication between the application teams and platform teams.

In this position, you will be expected to:

  • Validate Solutions/Implementations: Ensure that solutions and implementations align with the outlined tasks and business requirements. Conduct thorough validations to maintain the integrity and efficiency of the platform.
  • Independently Problem Solve: Demonstrate the ability to identify and solve business problems independently. Develop small components to address specific challenges without relying on explicit architecture diagrams.
  • Understand Medium-Level Tasking: Comprehend how medium-level tasks contribute to the achievement of overall goals. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate various components into a cohesive and functional platform.
  • Estimate Time and Effort: Provide accurate time and effort estimates for medium-sized tasks. Assist in project planning and resource allocation based on estimated timelines.
  • Demonstrate Programming Language Proficiency: Possess familiarity with at least one programming language. Exhibit a basic understanding of when to use a programming language versus a shell for efficient task execution.
  • Own the Bridge Between Application Development and Production: Own the bridge between the Application Development team(s) and the Production Environment.

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Clearance & Travel Requirements

  • Clearance Requirement: Active Secret clearance highly preferred.
  • Travel Expectations: 10%–25%.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer or similar role, with a focus on system architecture and development.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud-native technologies such as Kubernetes, Google Cloud, and Docker.
  • Familiarity with continuous delivery, distributed architectures, systems, everything-as-code, containerization, and cloud services.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Ansible) and a basic understanding of shell scripting.
  • Proficient with YAML.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Comfort with debugging systems and reading/writing code.
  • Knowledgeable about DevSecOps/DevOps and CI/CD theory.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a clearance.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance or higher.
  • Experienced in working on a team following an Agile framework in a remote environment.
  • Experience with security automation and familiarity with API Security, Container Security, and Cloud Security.
  • Familiar with architecture security design, monitoring, and performance instrumentation in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Possess a DoD 8570 IAT II certification.
  • Experienced in Department of Defense work, specifically working on a production Authority to Operate (ATO’d) system.

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Over 600 employees strong, Asure sees Human Capital Management (HCM) through the lens of entrepreneurs and executives with an owner’s mentality. Our HCM platform empowers more than 100,000 clients to build great teams and better manage their people while staying compliant in an ever-changing HR legislative landscape. Our HCM Sales Executive is responsible for building business relationships with new perspective clients as well as current customers and creating new revenue opportunities for the company’s platform of Human Capital Management solutions.

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred. 
  • Experience selling payroll, HR or related software and services is preferred. 
  • Minimum of 3 years consultative software sales experience. 
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Experience managing multiple sales engagements effectively. 
  • Proven relationship building and client service skills. 
  • Proven ability to manage a territory producing exceptional results. 
  • Proactive, results-oriented, and team-oriented approach to sales. 
  • Experience with Salesforce.com and other virtual selling tools such as GoToMeeting, Webex or other comparable tools. 
  • Must have a valid U.S. Driver's License to be eligible for hire. 

Compensation

The on target earnings (OTE) range for this position is $110,000 - $133,000 annually, based on relevant experience, skills, and industry knowledge. The compensation package includes an uncapped commission structure. Asure Software offers a variety of employee benefits. Salary information is determined by market location and is provided in accordance with state and local pay-transparency laws. Applicants should apply via

To provide Human Capital Management (HCM) software and services that help companies grow, while nurturing a culture of growth around us.

Be the most trusted Human Capital Management resource to entrepreneurs everywhere.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US, as we are unable to sponsor or transfer Visas at this time.

Position Summary

The Customer Care Representative provides outstanding service to our customers by responding to a high level of inbound customer calls, inquiries and requests which may require research and investigation to reach resolution. The incumbent actively engages customers to ensure complete understanding of the issues and provide accurate and efficient responses in a prompt, respectful and courteous manner.

We’re excited to offer this as a remote role! At this time, we can only consider applicants who live and work in VT, NH, NY, CT, MA, ME, DE, MD, PA, WV & NJ due to state-specific employment regulations.

Hiring Range: $20.00-$22.00 per hour, plus incentive pay and ample opportunities for advancement with our career paths program.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answers or places calls to customers to learn about and/or address their needs, concerns, or other issues with products or services.
  • Responds efficiently and accurately to customers, explaining possible solutions, and ensuring our customers feel supported and valued.
  • Engages in active listening with customers, confirming or clarifying information and diffusing escalated situations, as needed.
  • Builds instant rapport with customers and lasting relationships with other call center team members based on trust and reliability.
  • Utilizes job-specific software, databases, scripts, and tools appropriately when addressing a variety of different topics presented by customers.
  • Understands and strives to meet or exceed call center metrics while providing excellent consistent customer service.
  • Engages with customers to assess needs and makes sales recommendations for products or services that may better suit identified customer needs.
  • Participates in training and other learning opportunities to expand knowledge of the company, products, sales and services and performs any other duties needed to help drive our vision, fulfill our mission, and/or abide by our core values.

Career Path Definitions & Distinctions

Level I: 0-2 years of progressively complex experience in the customer service field. Demonstrated knowledge and competence in Casella’s business products and services as well as in customer service and client relationship management. Able to effectively manage call volume and understand proprietary software systems. Works within team to support Division sales representatives and provide excellent customer support.
