Overview
Stelic is seeking a Senior Project Scheduler to support a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility and support buildings in Puerto Rico, delivered in multiple packages using a modular construction approach. This position is responsible for schedule development and documentation in Primavera P6, pull planning with trade partners in Touchplan, and building reporting tools the project team uses to track schedule health, staffing coverage, and commissioning readiness.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and maintain the Primavera P6 schedule across multiple construction, engineering, and enabling works packages.
  • Own the Basis of Schedule, including integration of modular fabrication scope (coordination periods, work task protocols, WBS, and milestones).
  • Maintain the Schedule Build Assumption Log so logic, duration, and sequencing assumptions are documented and traceable.
  • Define WBS structure and location coding, and translate the engineering and design schedule into briefings for project stakeholders.
  • Review schedule quality, including critical path, total float, data date status, and open-ended logic.
  • Run pull planning in Touchplan and keep it aligned with the P6 schedule.
  • Facilitate schedule building and pull planning sessions with trade partners.
  • Train trade partners on the 6-week lookahead, session facilitation, and Percent Plan Complete (PPC) tracking.
  • Develop pull planning tools and training materials.
  • Prepare workstream meeting agendas, meeting formats, and governance materials for active and upcoming packages.
  • Produce multi-package schedule timeline graphics for leadership reviews.
  • Build and maintain reporting tools for staffing coverage, schedule health, and P6 schedule data (XER/XML).
  • Track CQV document workflow stages (PFCs, SOPs, commissioning protocols, IOQ protocols) and procurement readiness across project systems.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of scheduling and project controls experience on large, complex construction projects.
  • Advanced Primavera P6 proficiency, including XER/XML schedule data.
  • Experience running pull planning and short-interval planning, including 6-week lookaheads and PPC tracking.
  • Strong knowledge of Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling and schedule quality review.
  • Experience facilitating planning sessions with trade partners and training them on planning methods.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences manufacturing project experience.
  • Touchplan experience.
  • Experience integrating modular or off-site fabrication scope into project schedules.
  • Experience tracking CQV and commissioning readiness.
  • Experience building dashboards or reporting tools (Excel, HTML/JavaScript).
  • AACE PSP, PMI-SP, or PMP certification.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or a related field.

Primarily remote, supporting a project team in Puerto Rico.

The most valuable partnerships do more than generate opportunities. They open new markets, shape how teams go to market, and create lasting growth.

As our Channel Partner Manager at Summit, you’ll serve as an advanced channel partnerships expert, leading highly complex strategic relationships and shaping go-to-market priorities across an assigned market or partner portfolio. With full autonomy, you’ll evaluate growth opportunities, influence senior partner and internal stakeholders, and drive significant partner-sourced pipeline and recurring revenue.

Success in this role is measured by the strategic partnerships you advance, the direction you help shape, and the sustained commercial impact you deliver.

What You’ll Do:
  • Lead and expand a portfolio of highly strategic or complex channel partnerships, building senior-level relationships and identifying opportunities for sustained growth.
  • Evaluate, prioritize, and develop high-potential partners and market opportunities, applying specialized channel expertise to guide investment of time and resources.
  • Shape and lead sophisticated joint go-to-market strategies, aligning partner capabilities, market positioning, account priorities, and Summit’s growth objectives.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Summit’s cloud, infrastructure, colocation, and managed services value proposition within complex partner ecosystems.
  • Guide complex partner-sourced pursuits with partner leadership and Summit Sales, navigating competing priorities, negotiations, and extended enterprise sales cycles.
  • Own strategic partner-sourced pipeline and revenue outcomes, exercising full autonomy in prioritizing opportunities and adapting commercial strategies.
  • Design high-impact partner engagement and enablement approaches, including executive planning, joint campaigns, events, and targeted incentives.
  • Interpret partner performance, market signals, and pipeline trends to recommend strategic changes and unlock new sources of growth.
  • Influence senior stakeholders across Partner Operations, Marketing, Product, Sales, and Delivery to align priorities, resolve complex challenges, and strengthen partner outcomes.
What You’ll Deliver:
  • Sustained growth and recurring revenue from a portfolio of strategically important channel partnerships.
  • Sophisticated go-to-market strategies that open new opportunities and improve Summit’s position within key partner ecosystems.
  • A high-quality partner-sourced pipeline and measurable revenue outcomes across complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Scalable partner engagement and enablement approaches that strengthen partner capability, market awareness, and joint execution.
  • Strategic recommendations and cross-functional alignment that improve partner performance and inform channel priorities.
You’ll Thrive in This Role If You:
  • Bring 8+ years of relevant channel sales, strategic partnerships, or partner management experience, including ownership of complex partner relationships and commercial outcomes.
  • Have deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, IaaS, managed services, colocation, application hosting, or related enterprise technology solutions.
  • Are recognized for specialized channel expertise and can build credibility with senior partner leaders, executives, and field sellers.
  • Have a sustained record of delivering significant pipeline and revenue results through strategic partnerships.
  • Can shape sophisticated go-to-market strategies, navigate complex negotiations, and influence decisions across organizations.

ABOUT VICTAULIC

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world's most critical and prestigious structures.

An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation

At Victaulic, we're committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

Let's Build a Better World Together.

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

  • We build from within.
  • We stand behind our people.
  • We foster an environment for constant learning.
  • We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE

We're looking for a Project Billing Coordinator Lead to join our Virtual Design & Construction (VDC) team in Easton, PA, reporting to the VDC Intake Manager. In this role, you'll manage the billing lifecycle of sold projects, from initial order intake through final invoicing, while leading the Intake and Billing team by providing training and support to the coordinators. You'll work closely with Sales, Credit, and management. Success in this role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational and leadership skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic business environment.

Project Intake

  • Obtain and maintain tax exemption certificates where applicable.
  • Determine the proper Billing Type for each project.
  • Obtain approvals and required signatures.
  • Update systems with proper pricing.

Invoicing & Billing

  • Confirm all shipped orders are processed properly to support invoice releases.
  • Gather and organize all required backup documentation.
  • Communicate with Sales and/or customers when necessary.
  • Track and reconcile project billing against approved schedules of values.
  • Maintain accurate records of invoices, change orders, and project documentation.

Change Orders & Project Close Out

  • Prepare projects for close out.

Leadership: Training

  • Assist in the development and maintenance of training materials and documentation.

Leadership: Team Support

  • Serve as the first point of escalation for the Coordinator team on day-to-day questions and issues.
  • Support coverage during absences or peak volume.
  • Review team output for accuracy and consistency, and coach team members on improvements.

Leadership: Management Liaison

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the team and management.
  • Communicate priorities, process changes, and business updates.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, with advanced Excel skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply generative AI, automation, and data tools to improve productivity and quality of work.
  • Excellent communication, organization, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
  • Detail-oriented and adaptable in a fast-changing business environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport across teams and departments.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to train, coach, and motivate others.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment in resolving escalated issues.
  • Ability to prioritize and delegate work across a team while managing a personal workload.
  • Comfort presenting information and reporting to management.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Experience with Smartsheet.

WHAT WE OFFER

Build A Better Career

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from within
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities

Build A Better Future

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Retirement savings plans with company match
  • Life insurance and disability coverage

Build A Better You

  • Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable
  • Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources
  • Inclusive, team-oriented culture where people look out for one another

Build A Better World

Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day.

Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

GPS is Greystar's proprietary operational analytics and Intelligence platform and the primary source of truth for property-level performance across the world’s largest multifamily portfolio. GPS runs on 30 years of data, context and intelligence and serves property operations, asset management, investment management, and finance — across a multi-PMS estate spanning Yardi, Entrata, and RealPage, and across US, UK, European, and APAC markets. GPS is an AI native platform and the future of Asset Management at Greystar.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management to own the GPS product end to end: what gets built, in what order, for whom, and against what definition of value. This is not just a delivery-coordination role, but it also isn’t a sole leader role. This is a Technical Product Leader who can work across teams and internal customers, build team unity and momentum, drive to decisions and create and run process and keep a team of rock star AI-forward designers and engineers cranking! You can fly at 30,000 feet and also play at ground level with the latest in AI tools. The person in this seat helps set roadmap direction, arbitrates between competing business demands, and is accountable for milestones that build GPS to a platform that changes how Greystar operates.

The role is deliberately cross-company and is about detail and influence more than management. Success requires sustained working relationships with senior operators and investors who do not report into the technology team as well as being the point of operations and alignment across a remote team of builders. This role is for a builder communicator who wants to drive a global platform forward at scale, push the wins to the teams, and own the inevitable stumbles along the way.

JOB DESCRIPTION

What You Will Own

Cross-functional demand management

  • Serve as the intake and arbitration point for GPS demand from property management, asset management, investment management, and corporate finance. Drive prioritization and sequence.
  • In partnership with UX, help run structured discovery with senior stakeholders. Distinguish stated requests from underlying needs.
  • Work to bring the teams along so that the businesses see your role, and GPS, as a weapon to help them attack the market. Teamwork at Greystar is everything.

Tactical team and sprint management

  • Own the Kanban process (we use Linear) and drive an adaptable but disciplined sprint process across engineers, designers, UX experts, business leaders and data engineers.
  • Aling with multiple stakeholders on roadmap, near and long-term priorities, and drive deliverables and outcomes via on time delivery.

Product strategy and roadmap

  • Own the GPS multi-quarter roadmap and the reasoning behind it. Maintain a defensible prioritization model that survives executive pressure and aligns with Greystar’s global priorities.
  • Translate operational and investment problems into product scope. Kill work that does not earn its place.
  • Define and defend the boundary between GPS (the product) and DMP (the platform) — what belongs in the product versus the underlying data infrastructure.

Delivery partnership

  • Work daily with the builders and workstream leads across pipeline and orchestration, architecture, permissions and entitlements, infrastructure, and business stakeholder coordination.
  • Own requirements, acceptance criteria, and UAT outcomes. Own the release narrative.
  • Hold the line on quality where data trust is at stake — a wrong number in GPS costs more credibility than a late feature.
  • Run deep with the data and data engineering teams to troubleshoot and understand solutions when data discrepancies arise.

Qualifications

Required

  • 8+ years in product management, with at least 3 years owning enterprise data, analytics, or reporting products used by non-technical business users.
  • You are a product manager, tactical operator and also a builder. You tinker with AI, Openclaw, Cowork or anything else that keeps you building and learning. You push to production.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a product where the primary value was trusted numbers — including responsibility for metric definitions, not just interfaces.
  • Working fluency with modern data platform concepts: lakehouse and medallion patterns, semantic and reporting layers, data lineage, row- and column-level entitlements, pipeline SLAs. You do not need to build them; you need to reason about trade-offs with the people who do.
  • Track record of operating across a large organization without authority over the stakeholders you depend on, including evidence of arbitrating between senior stakeholders with conflicting interests.
  • Ability to write for and present to executive audiences — concise, numbers-first, with the reasoning available on request.

Strongly preferred (but not required for rock stars who don’t have the below experience)

  • Real estate, property management, Financial or PropTech domain experience; familiarity with Yardi, Entrata, or RealPage data models.
  • Experience in a multi-source-system environment where the same concept is represented differently by each system.
  • Experience with global rollout where operational definitions vary by market (US vs. UK/EU vs. APAC).
  • Exposure to data governance and metric certification programs.

The salary range for this position is $160,000 - $180,000 USD Annually.


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

*Benefits offered for full-time employees. For Union and Prevailing Wage roles, compensation and benefits may vary from the listed information above due to Collective Bargaining Agreements and/or local governing authority.


Greystar will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Greystar is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


This position may be performed remotely anywhere within the United States except the state of Alaska.


Important Notice: Greystar will never request your banking details or other sensitive personal information during the interview process. Greystar does not conduct any interviews via text or messaging, and all communication will come from official Greystar email addresses (@greystar.com). If you receive suspicious requests, please report them immediately to .

January 29, 2027

OneDigital is an equal opportunity employer. Not only as a matter of standard, but to honor and celebrate our differences. We believe that the power of ONE starts with you. We are committed to cultivating and preserving a culture that celebrates diversity, insists on equity and inclusion, and connects us. raw.description:
About Us:
HeadQuarters is a global start-up that partners with US cannabis companies to provide support in finance, sales operations, and logistics. We are currently seeking an Customer Billing and Support Associate to join our growing accounting team.

The Opportunity:
As a Customer Billing and Support Associate with HeadQuarters, you will be responsible for managing and monitoring receivables, preparing and processing invoices, and supporting customers with billing-related inquiries and account matters. We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized professional with excellent English and strong communication skills who is comfortable working with numbers and financial information and is ready to grow in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

The working hours for this role are 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST, depending on the client.
In Serbia, this corresponds to 3:00 PM–11:00 PM or 6:00 PM–2:00 AM, respectively.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collections & Aging Management: Manage and maintain aged accounts receivable across wholesale retail accounts, ensuring timely collection efforts and resolution of delinquent balances.
  • Proactive Follow-Up: Monitor aging reports and proactively follow up on upcoming and past-due invoices through phone calls, emails, and written correspondence while maintaining accurate documentation of all account activity, customer communication, and collection efforts.
  • Dispute Resolution: Investigate, resolve, and reconcile account discrepancies, invoice disputes, deductions, short payments, and unapplied cash in a timely and professional manner.
  • Payment Processing: Process, apply, and reconcile customer payments and credit memos accurately within Dynamics and Acumatica ERP systems.
  • Credit Risk Monitoring: Monitor customer credit risk, review payment trends, assist with payment term requests, and support credit reviews for new and existing retail accounts.
  • Sales Partnership: Partner with sales personnel to manage customer accounts, review credit limits, enforce credit holds on delinquent accounts, and balance collections priorities with customer relationship management.
  • Account Reconciliation: Perform account reconciliations and support retail partners with statement reviews, payment research, and dispute resolution.
  • Risk Escalation: Identify delinquent or high-risk accounts and recommend payment arrangements, escalations, third-party collections, or legal action when necessary.
  • Reporting: Maintain accurate account records and prepare reporting related to AR aging, account status, collections activity, and critical account updates.
  • Leadership Engagement: Participate in weekly meetings with the CFO and Financial Controller to provide updates on critical accounts, collection risks, and overall AR performance.

Qualifications:

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Previous experience in billing, finance, accounting, collections, customer support, or a similar role is a plus.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with numbers, data, and financial information.
  • Experience working with ERP systems is a plus; familiarity with Dynamics or Acumatica is an advantage.

Benefits

🌍 Work fully remotely in a flexible and collaborative environment

💼 Build your expertise inbilling and customer accounts while supporting leading U.S. cannabis companies

📈 Grow your career through hands-on experience, ownership, and continuous learning

Our Values
We are guided by curiosity, collaboration, and persistence. We seek to understand deeply, work collectively to solve complex challenges, and remain resilient in pursuit of meaningful, long-term impact. These principles shape how we operate as a team and how we support the success of our clients.

👉Take a look at this short video 🎥 featuring a few words from the CEO about our company, industry insights, and founding HQ!

Looking forward to meeting you!

raw.description:
At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together.

The Crown Is Yours

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Lottery Intelligence Team, you’ll build and scale machine learning solutions that turn complex operational data into accurate, reliable customer experiences. You’ll lead the development of computer vision and multimodal models, taking innovative solutions from experimentation to real-world deployment. Working alongside Engineering and cross-functional teams, you’ll improve model performance, strengthen customer trust, and help expand lottery fulfillment capabilities into new markets nationwide.

What you’ll do as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer

  • Design, train, and optimize computer vision and multimodal machine learning models that transform complex inputs into accurate, structured data.
  • Fine-tune and evaluate multimodal models using techniques such as LoRA and hyperparameter optimization to improve accuracy, speed, and cost efficiency.
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that prepare, validate, and organize production data for model training, testing, and evaluation.
  • Develop robust evaluation frameworks and performance metrics to compare models, measure accuracy, and guide deployment decisions.
  • Deploy and manage machine learning models on scalable cloud infrastructure, using automated scaling, monitoring, and controlled rollouts to maintain reliable performance.
  • Integrate machine learning models into real-time processing systems and enhance computer vision capabilities, including image preprocessing, barcode decoding, and optical character recognition.
  • Partner with Engineering, Fulfillment Operations, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, improve operational workflows, and strengthen the systems supporting lottery fulfillment.
  • Elevate engineering standards through code reviews, technical documentation, automated testing, and mentorship while contributing to the team's broader data infrastructure.


What you’ll bring

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with at least 3 years of machine learning engineering experience.
  • Proven experience developing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning models in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices, including automated testing, data validation, and asynchronous programming.
  • Hands-on experience with computer vision, multimodal or vision-language models, and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, or vLLM.
  • Experience with model fine-tuning, prompt design, performance evaluation, and image processing tools such as OpenCV.
  • Experience with cloud-based machine learning platforms, preferably Google Cloud, and familiarity with containerization, orchestration, and monitoring tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, or Datadog.
  • Strong technical ownership, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to lead complex initiatives, explain technical decisions, and collaborate across teams.
  • Familiarity with Kotlin, Java, message-driven architectures, or Protocol Buffers is a plus, as is experience in lottery, gaming, financial technology, or other regulated industries.

Join Our Team

We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is 134,400.00 USD - 168,000.00 USD, plus bonus, equity, and benefits as applicable. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The compensation information displayed on each job posting reflects the range for new hire pay rates for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range and how that was determined during the hiring process. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Position Summary

The Software Developer II designs, builds, tests, and supports enterprise Salesforce solutions on a large enterprise Salesforce platform. These two positions are dedicated to the transition from Salesforce Education Data Architecture (EDA) to Salesforce Education Cloud. The developer works in an Agile delivery environment with frequent production releases. This is a hands-on development position requiring immediate proficiency in Salesforce development and the Salesforce education data model.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and custom objects.

Meet Domaine, the world's largest independent Shopify design and development partner, formed by the union of Half Helix and Tomorrow. We are a team of commerce experts dedicated to creating, building, and growing beloved brands. As pioneers and not just participants in our industry, we are inspired to write, break, and re-write the rules for a new generation of commerce.

We are looking for an experienced backend Tech Lead, which is a client-facing role with plenty of hands-on development and ownership over our technical approaches and estimates. In this role, you bring a proven ability to ship production-ready code in an agency environment, often with requirements that are somewhat open-ended. You share accountability for the success of your projects and growth of your teammates. At this stage in your career, you’ve seen most common Shopify integration patterns and are comfortable tackling novel problems while trying to anticipate risk. You recognize that there is always more to learn, and actively look for feedback on your solutions and ask for opinions and support early.

This role helps large, mature “enterprise” brands migrate to Shopify, and will require experience with common systems in this space (ERP, OMS, IMS, PIM, POS, etc) and the common integration workstreams: order management lifecycles, product data models, data migrations, omni-channel and payments. This is a big space, so some on-the-job learning is expected, but tangible experience in some of these areas is critical, including being able to evaluate when off-the-shelf vs custom is appropriate.

This role is also open to candidates outside of North America in locations where Domaine can legally employ, provided they are able to work U.S. Eastern Time Zone hours.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Development

You can design and implement reliable, efficient, and secure integrations using PHP/Laravel or JS/Node. Your expertise includes optimizing databases and queues, and generally how your infrastructure choices affect throughput and reliability. You ensure projects are well tested, and can implement a solid CI/CD pipeline.

Client Relations

You can think on your feet, communicating complex technical concepts to clients and negotiating on requirements, resources, timelines, and scope in order to protect overall project success. You are solution-focused, making use of technical calls, emails, written documentation, diagrams, or any means necessary to ensure the client has what they need to succeed. You can provide timely advice on how to integrate with Shopify, offering insights on middleware architecture and design principles.

Project Leadership

You can clearly communicate the status of a project as a whole, and raise challenges or uncertainty early. You assist with development timelines and in grooming, assigning, and releasing work. You supervise the team’s output and can spot when someone needs guidance, helping others to solve problems collaboratively through paired programming and quality code reviews.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Development and DevOps: Proficiency with PHP/Laravel or JS/Node, PostgreSQL, and AWS is required. You are comfortable working in the command-line and working with Linux based operating systems. Experience with React is not essential but nice to have.
  • Data Management: Experience in data modeling, data mapping, and data migration between systems.
  • E-commerce Expertise: Good understanding of the Shopify data model and hands-on experience with Shopify APIs. Knowledge of other enterprise e-commerce systems is valued.
  • Mentorship and Leadership: Ability to collaboratively solve problems and share knowledge. This role does not have direct reports, but people management experience a plus.

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Retirement savings plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy with paid time off at end of year
  • Flexible working schedule
  • Remote-first culture

Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Über die Position

Du wirst Teil des Teams IT Infrastructure innerhalb des Bereichs IT Operations, das die interne IT-Infrastruktur der shopware AG betreut. Als Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - AWS (m/w/d) sorgst du für den stabilen Betrieb, die Automatisierung und die Weiterentwicklung unserer AWS-Umgebungen und Netzwerkarchitektur. Gemeinsam mit internen Expert:innen und externen Partnern, darunter AWS-Spezialist:innen, stellst du eine stabile, leistungsfähige und zukunftssichere Systemlandschaft sicher und gestaltest die technische Basis von Shopware aktiv mit.

KI in der IT-Infrastruktur von Shopware

Künstliche Intelligenz wird zunehmend zu einem festen Bestandteil unserer Infrastruktur. Vom Model Routing und Hosting von KI-Modellen bis hin zu Cloud- und selbstverwalteten Infrastrukturen schaffen wir die Grundlage, um KI sicher, effizient und skalierbar zu betreiben. Wir möchten, dass du diese Entwicklung aktiv mitgestaltest.

Dein Arbeitsort

Vor Ort, hybrid oder vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Vorfeld gemeinsam vereinbart und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags.

Requirements

  • Du entwickelst unsere AWS-Architektur kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst für stabile, leistungsfähige und kosteneffiziente Umgebungen.

  • Du gestaltest unsere KI-Infrastruktur aktiv mit – vom Model Routing bis zum Hosting von KI-Modellen in Cloud- und selbstverwalteten Umgebungen.

  • Du automatisierst unsere Infrastruktur mit Terraform und setzt auf Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

  • Du konzipierst und optimierst unsere Netzwerkarchitektur als Grundlage für eine skalierbare Infrastruktur.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das Monitoring und die Überwachung des Zustands unserer Infrastruktur.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Security Specialist zusammen, um die Sicherheit unserer Systeme kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Du bereitest Monitoring- und Kostendaten in aussagekräftigen Reports und Analysen auf und schaffst damit eine fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlage.

  • Du begleitest Projekte von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung und arbeitest dabei eng mit den Teams Cloud Engineering und Infrastructure zusammen.

  • Du teilst dein Wissen mit deinen Kolleg:innen und trägst aktiv zum Aufbau und zur Pflege unserer internen Wissensdatenbank bei.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du verfügst über mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Cloud Infrastructure, Systems Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Cloud-Umgebungen, insbesondere AWS, und bringst fundierte Linux-Kenntnisse mit.

  • Du hast ein breites Verständnis von Netzwerk- und Infrastruktursystemen und kannst komplexe Umgebungen betreiben und weiterentwickeln.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Terraform oder einem vergleichbaren Infrastructure-as-Code-Tool.

  • Du kennst dich mit Monitoring-Tools wie CloudWatch aus und kannst aussagekräftige Systemberichte erstellen.

  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit CI/CD, GitHub oder GitHub Actions mit.

  • Du interessierst dich für KI-Infrastruktur – erste praktische Erfahrungen in diesem Bereich sind ein Plus.

  • Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine teamorientierte Arbeitsweise im Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.

  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative und Neugier mit und hast Freude daran, bestehende Systeme kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Du verfügst über fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Josephine Scheffler und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

raw.description:
Crimson Education helps ambitious students apply to the world’s top universities. Crimson students have received more than 1,490 Ivy League offers.

This role sits within AdmitYogi, Crimson’s lighter-touch college admissions mentoring program. Students work one-on-one with a current Ivy League student or graduate. Some join us early in high school for long-term mentoring, building a multi-year roadmap and meeting their mentor every two weeks to put it into action. Others join closer to applications for focused support with their college list, essays and applications.

The role

You’ll lead Zoom strategy calls with students and parents who have already booked time with AdmitYogi. You’ll get to know the student, answer the family’s questions about college admissions, and recommend a mentoring or application support package that fits their goals and timeline.

Most families take time to decide, so follow-up is a core part of the job. You’ll set aside time each shift to send tailored proposals, answer questions, and help families make an informed decision. You’ll report directly to Todd Anderson, AdmitYogi’s CEO.

What you’ll do

  • Lead scheduled Zoom calls with students and parents and answer questions about admissions timelines, testing, extracurriculars, and essays.

  • Recommend the right AdmitYogi package for each student and explain what’s included and what it costs. Give families honest advice and avoid promising admissions outcomes.

  • Own the sales process from the first call through enrollment, including following up, closing sales, and meeting sales targets.

  • Send personalized follow-up emails and proposals, keep track of each family’s next step, and guide them through enrollment.

  • Follow up by text and email when families miss a scheduled call.

  • Keep HubSpot up to date and brief the student’s mentor on what you learned once the family enrolls.

Who you are

  • Dependable. Families set aside time to meet with you. You might have 20 calls booked in a week, and you're the type of person who won't miss one, week after week.

  • Proactive. You follow through on what you promise, keep your pipeline organized, and know when to reach out again.

  • Quick to learn. We’ll train you on AdmitYogi’s programs and sales process. You’ll be expected to build enough admissions knowledge to answer families’ questions confidently.

  • Warm, curious, and honest. You enjoy speaking with parents and teenagers, ask thoughtful questions, and give families room to decide.

Experience in sales, admissions counseling, tutoring, or another client-facing role is a plus. So is firsthand experience with the US college admissions process or familiarity with a CRM such as HubSpot.

Hours and pay

  • Hours: 15–25 hours per week. You’ll work at least three evenings a week, ideally four or five.

  • Schedule: 4:30–9:30 p.m. Eastern Time on your scheduled evenings, including paid time for follow-up.

  • Pay: US$20 per hour plus 5% commission on payments received from families you enroll. Commission is paid monthly and includes future installments as they’re collected.

  • Typical earnings: around US$35–45 per hour all-in, growing the longer you’re with us.

  • Location: Fully remote within the US.

  • Start dates: December 2026 for the first hire, with additional hires starting in mid-January 2027.

If you enjoy talking with students and parents and helping families make informed decisions about college admissions support, we’d love to hear from you.

To apply, submit your résumé, tell us which evenings you can consistently work, and record a ~90 second response to a sample family call.

After you apply, please check your spam or junk folder for updates from Teamtailor.

raw.description:
We are knowmad mood!

Somos una compañía líder en transformación digital, en constante evolución y a la vanguardia de la tecnología.

Formado por más de 3.000 personas creativas, digitales e innovadoras conectadas a un propósito y capaces de generar conexiones con personas de todo el mundo. Un equipo responsable, flexible y con alta capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y del mercado, a la vez que proporciona valor, visión, creatividad, expertise, profesionalidad y pasión por la tecnología en cada proyecto.

Los valores que marcan nuestro rumbo y nos guían hacia la excelencia son la colaboración, la innovación, el compromiso, la diversión y la conﬁanza.

Únete a nuestro equipo como 💻AI ARCHITECT 💻 para un importante cliente del sector bancario.

¿Cuál será tu misión en el proyecto?

Diseñar y evolucionar la plataforma de IA corporativa como producto que habilite a los equipos a construir, desplegar y operar capacidades de IA y sistemas agénticos de forma autónoma, segura y trazable, sobre el ecosistema híbrido de la entidad. El ámbito cubre la capa de acceso y mediación a modelos, el gobierno de su uso y su coste, la integración de la IA en el ciclo de vida del desarrollo mediante entornos de ejecución agénticos (harness) y el diseño de los controles que hacen ese uso auditable y conforme al marco regulatorio. El rol abarca tanto el diseño como la construcción de la plataforma y acompaña el producto a lo largo de toda su vida.

Requisitos mínimos

• Experiencia en roles de arquitectura técnica, habitualmente a partir de 5 años en su dominio de especialización.

• Experiencia demostrada y profunda en al menos uno de los entornos del ecosistema corporativo: on-prem (Kubernetes on-prem, VMware) o cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), con comprensión del modelo híbrido.

• Diseño e implantación de plataformas de IA de autoservicio: mediación de acceso a modelos (AI gateway), credenciales, enrutado, cuotas y control de coste.

• Arquitectura de sistemas agénticos: orquestación, gestión de contexto, integración de herramientas (MCP, function calling) y patrones RAG.

• Harness engineering: diseño del entorno de ejecución de los agentes (contexto, herramientas, aislamiento, permisos y verificación) para que su resultado sea repetible y revisable.

• Gobierno de modelos: ciclo de vida de modelos aprobados, criterios de selección, evaluación de calidad y trazabilidad del uso.

• Seguridad específica de IA: prompt injection, fuga de datos y aislamiento de la ejecución de agentes.

• Observabilidad y control de coste sobre el uso de modelos y agentes.

• Integración de la IA en el SSDLC: pipelines CI/CD, IaC y ejecución de agentes en Kubernetes.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Horario flexible ⏰: horario flexible entrada 8.30h salida 18h con viernes intensivo de 8h a 15h y en verano (julio y agosto) intensivo de 8h a 15h

  • Vacaciones 🌴: 22 días de vacaciones + 2 días de libre disposición, además de los días 24 y 31 de diciembre libres.

  • Contrato indefinido 📄: Desde el primer día, con opción de 12 o 14 pagas.

  • Retribución flexible 💳: Tarjeta restaurante, cheque guardería, seguro médico, formación y otros beneficios con ventajas fiscales.

  • Club de ventajas 🎁: Descuentos en tecnología, ocio y formación.

  • Formación continua 📚: Acceso a Udemy Business, cursos de idiomas, certificaciones oficiales y formación técnica.

  • Plan de carrera 🚀: Acompañamiento para crecer, especializarte o asumir nuevos retos.

  • Bienestar integral 💚: Programas de nutrición, actividad física y equilibrio emocional.

  • Conciliación +VIDA 👨 👩 👧 👦: Asistencia personal y familiar 24/7.

  • Ambiente inclusivo 🌍: Entorno diverso y multicultural.

  • Eventos sociales 🎮: Actividades para conectar con el equipo.

¡Apúntate y te daremos más detalles! 🚀

Para estar al corriente de nuestras novedades síguenos aquí ->knowmad mood

Enknowmad moodnos comprometemos con la igualdad de oportunidades y el respeto a la diversidad. Aplicamos nuestro Plan de Igualdad y el principio de no discriminación en todos nuestros procesos de selección.

raw.excerpt: Role summary The Project Manager III plans and coordinates all aspects of large-scale Data Center network builds and retrofits from initiation to delivery, including AI implementations.
raw.description:
Role summary

The Project Manager III plans and coordinates all aspects of large-scale Data Center network builds and retrofits from initiation to delivery, including AI implementations. Working with project coordinators, deployment engineers, data center technicians, site teams, program partners, logistics providers, and internal customers, the PM III turns approved intake and roadmap requirements into clear execution plans. This role defines project requirements, conducts feasibility and needs/impact assessments, and manages all implementation processes including asset management, resource allocation, progress tracking, change control monitoring, documentation, training, and on-time delivery within budget constraints across projects of varying number, size, and complexity.


The successful candidate understands the purpose of the work, connects technical and material dependencies to the schedule, identifies what is preventing progress, and brings the right people together to resolve it. After structured onboarding, the PM III is expected to lead familiar deployment scopes independently within established decision rights, while seeking engineering clarification for new or ambiguous technical scope.


The assigned portfolio may span multiple sites and include new-build network deployments, retrofits, platform changes, capacity additions, migrations and selected non-repeatable initiatives.


Key responsibilities

Project intake, planning and kickoff

  • Partner with functional teams during initiation, planning, design, procurement, deployment, and post-deployment phases; participate in defining project scope and objectives involving all relevant stakeholders to ensure technical feasibility.
  • Review engineering deployment plans and the bill of materials (BOM) with the deployment engineer; confirm delivery locations, site readiness, dependencies, and discrepancies before committing detailed execution plans.
  • Coordinate the appropriate deployment engineer, site execution partners and logistics support with their responsible leads; document who owns each activity.
  • Create or coordinate the appropriate workstreams and role assignments using the approved process.
  • Schedule and lead focused kickoff discussions and regularly scheduled meetings with core teams to establish scope, responsibilities, milestones, material need-by dates, risks, and next actions.

Portfolio and delivery ownership

  • Maintain the assigned site/region roadmap and project trackers, incorporating inputs and tracking program milestones, timelines, and overall deliverables for multiple cross-functional network deployment projects.
  • Coordinate interdependent engineering, field, material and site-readiness activities. Identify the critical blockers, responsible owners, recovery actions and expected resolution dates.
  • Lead recurring delivery reviews, measure project performance using metrics and KPIs via appropriate tools, and maintain steady updates without unnecessary duplicate meetings.
  • Keep schedule dates, roles, comments, and status accurate; monitor change control processes, date comments, preserve approved baselines, and advocate proper change management.
  • Reconcile portfolio coverage, supported work and handover records so transferred ownership, incomplete tags or engineer-owned work do not disappear from delivery visibility.

Materials and field coordination

  • Responsible for asset and material management across data centers and warehouses, partnering with the PC on BOM completeness, inbound material availability, need-by dates, site receiving readiness, and delivery sequencing.
  • Ensure material plans support the actual deployment sequence, including phased suite or megapod delivery where applicable.
  • Provide direction and resolve or escalate discrepancies affecting the schedule while the PC performs the assigned tactical tracking and material-request activities.
  • Coordinate with technical and field owners on installation, validation and readiness evidence; do not substitute an administrative update for an engineering deliverable.

Stakeholder communication, risk and closeout

  • Own clear communication for assigned projects; act as a main point of contact for vendor partners, internal stakeholders, and client executives, providing regular status updates, risk analysis, and progress metrics.
  • Identify and track risks, execute risk analysis and management techniques, and present feasible risk mitigation strategies when priorities, site capacity, material availability, or network restrictions conflict.
  • Engage in creating and maintaining comprehensive project documentation including schedules, reviews, process documents, and risk analysis; drive lifecycle milestones from concept commit through project closure.
  • Follow approved closeout and exception procedures.
  • Participate in portfolio and workload planning.

Continuity and continuous improvement

  • Prepare usable handovers covering scope, contacts, current dates, materials, open actions, risks, evidence and outstanding decisions.
  • Contribute practical examples, process documentation and lessons learned to the team's onboarding library and operating playbooks.
  • Support peer learning and mentoring within an agreed capacity plan; raise training or access gaps before they affect delivery.
  • Participate in internal process improvements to eliminate gaps across multiple teams/functions; evaluate post-project results against metrics to recommend or implement improvements to delivery processes.

Required qualifications — proposed for this draft

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.S./B.A.) with 2–5 years of related project management experience in a fast-paced environment supporting data centers, network hardware, or large-scale network lifecycles (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple, cross-functional technical projects concurrently, translating scope into detailed project plans, resource allocations, risk analysis, and tracking metrics.
  • Understanding of data center lifecycles, large-scale network deployment activities (equipment installation, rack/stack/cabling, site readiness, validation), and asset management across data centers and warehouses.
  • Strong track record of building productive internal and external working relationships with vendors, field teams, logistics partners, and client executives, exercising sound judgment within defined procedures to resolve conflicts and meet schedule timelines.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and documentation skills, including experience creating spreadsheets, presentation materials, meeting summaries, and process documentation.
  • Self-starter who can quickly learn new tools, processes, and technologies with minimal assistance, and work flexibly across multiple North American timezones (remotely or locally).
  • Ability to distinguish delivery progress, missing evidence and administrative closure, and maintain accurate records when stakeholders are pressing for completion.
  • Strong observational and analytical skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, risk mitigation, and metric tracking.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in hyperscale data centers, network infrastructure deployment or a managed-service delivery environment.
  • Experience with both new-build and retrofit/migration work, or with Optical terminal/transponder and capacity-add delivery interfaces.
  • Familiarity with deployment and material-management platforms.
  • Experience improving repeatable delivery processes and developing practical onboarding or knowledge-transfer material.
  • Relevant project management certifications (PMP, PgMP, PfMP, PPM, CPD, CPMP, etc.).

Salary Range

$80,640.00 - $134,400.00 USD (Salary)
  • Please note that the salary information provided herein is base pay only (gross); it does not include other forms of compensation which may or may not apply to this specific position, namely, performance-based bonuses, benefits-related payments, or other general incentives - none of which are guaranteed, may be subject to specific eligibility requirements, and are wholly within the discretion of Astreya to remit.
  • Further, the salary information noted above is a range that consists of a minimum and maximum rate of pay for this specific position. Where an applicant or employee is placed on this range will depend and be contingent on objective, documented work-related considerations like education, experience, certifications, licenses, preferred qualifications, among other factors.

Astreya offers comprehensive benefits to all Regular, Full-Time Employees,including:

  • Medical provided through UHC (PPO, HSA, Surest options) / Medical provided through Kaiser (HMO option only) for California employees only

  • Dental provided through UHC

  • Continuing Education and Professional Development via various integrated platforms, e.g. Udemy and Coursera

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including Pakistan, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands.

Pay: $45–$90/hr

Job Title: Clinical, Microbiome & Translational Research Scientist (PhD)

Job Type: Contractor

Location: Remote(Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Design and write challenging, expert-level scientific problems in microbiome/metagenomics, clinical and translational bioinformatics, and related life sciences, with clear, verifiable solutions.
  2. Review and evaluate AI model outputs for scientific accuracy, rigor, and depth of reasoning, catching subtle errors non-specialists would miss.
  3. Develop detailed rubrics and reference answers grounded in primary literature and established methodology.
  4. Apply domain expertise across areas such as 16S and shotgun metagenomics, virome/host-microbiome analysis, biomarker discovery, clinical genomics, and omics-driven precision medicine.
  5. Provide clear written explanations of your reasoning so other experts can follow and validate it.
  6. Meet quality standards through iterative feedback and peer review.

Required Qualifications (MUST)

  1. PhD in Microbiology, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Immunology, Epidemiology, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research experience in an academic or industry lab (wetlab experience is a plus).
  3. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).

Preferred Skills

  1. Postdoctoral or industry research experience in microbiome, clinical, or translational research.
  2. Publication record, ideally first-author papers in relevant journals.
  3. Microbiome tools: QIIME2, Kraken2, MetaPhlAn, HUMAnN, MAG assembly/binning, virome analysis.
  4. Clinical/translational: TCGA, UK Biobank, biomarker discovery, survival analysis, EHR + omics integration, oncology/immunology genomics.
  5. Statistics and ML for high-dimensional biological data.
  6. Programming: Python and/or R (required in practice), Bash, workflow tools.
  7. Experience reviewing, benchmarking, or writing scientific content.

How to apply

Apply here with your profile. We will then email you a link to complete yourapplication on the hiring platform — your application is only considered oncethat final step is done.
